AI BIJAN Motion - packed source files of this folder. Do not edit by hand.
The skill upload in the Claude app accepts at most 200 files, so the source files are packed here.
`node <skill folder>/new-project.mjs <project folder> --kit=<style>` unpacks them into the project.
Format: per file one line with four '=' signs, the byte length and the path, then exactly that many bytes.

==== 875 scripts/buildforge-check.ts
// BUILDFORGE construction-sequence QA (no GPU needed):
//   node --experimental-strip-types scripts/buildforge-check.ts
// Checks order (supports before loads, temporary works not struck while loaded), clashes between
// installed solids, and that everything is in place before the end. Point it at your own film's
// components and windows the same way (copy the three lines below per sequence).

import { checkSequence, report } from "../src/kits/buildforge/assembly/check.ts";
import { pavilionComponents } from "../src/kits/buildforge/example/pavilion.ts";
import { END, WINDOWS } from "../src/kits/buildforge/example/sequence.ts";

let ok = true;
{
  const r = checkSequence(pavilionComponents(), WINDOWS, { end: END, skip: (c) => c.phase === "setout" || c.phase === "strings" });
  ok = report("pavilion-example", r, WINDOWS.length) && ok;
}
process.exit(ok ? 0 : 1);

==== 4177 src/kits/buildforge/assembly/check.ts
// Construction-sequence QA without a GPU. Schedules the components, then checks
//  1. order — nothing starts before what it bears on (or must follow) is complete, and temporary
//     works are not struck while something still bears on them;
//  2. clashes — no two installed solids overlap in volume while both are on site (parts that
//     legitimately touch share faces, which is not an overlap);
//  3. timing — every component is in place before `end` (construction-clock units).
// Rotations other than multiples of 90° are checked with their axis-aligned envelope.

import { schedule, validate, type PhaseWindow, type Timeline } from "./schedule.ts";
import type { Component, Vec3 } from "../types.ts";

export type CheckResult = {
  ok: boolean;
  components: number;
  timeline: Timeline;
  order: string[];
  clashes: string[];
  late: string[];
};

type Box = { min: number[]; max: number[] };

const toWorld = (c: Component, [a, b]: [Vec3, Vec3]): Box => {
  const r = c.rotY ?? 0, cos = Math.cos(r), sin = Math.sin(r);
  const xs: number[] = [], zs: number[] = [];
  for (const x of [a[0], b[0]]) for (const z of [a[2], b[2]]) { xs.push(x * cos + z * sin + c.at[0]); zs.push(-x * sin + z * cos + c.at[2]); }
  return { min: [Math.min(...xs), c.at[1] + a[1], Math.min(...zs)], max: [Math.max(...xs), c.at[1] + b[1], Math.max(...zs)] };
};

const boxesOf = (c: Component): [Vec3, Vec3][] =>
  c.part.kind === "solid"
    ? c.part.boxes ?? [[c.part.bounds.min, c.part.bounds.max]]
    : c.part.pieces.filter((p) => !p.instant).map((p) => [p.c.map((v, k) => v - p.s[k] / 2) as Vec3, p.c.map((v, k) => v + p.s[k] / 2) as Vec3]);

/**
 * `skip` leaves components out of the clash test only (set-out on open ground, reinforcement cast
 * into a slab, planting). Planting (`grow`) is always skipped.
 */
export const checkSequence = (components: Component[], windows: PhaseWindow[], o: { end: number; skip?: (c: Component) => boolean; eps?: number }): CheckResult => {
  const timeline = schedule(components, windows);
  const order = validate(components, timeline);
  const EPS = o.eps ?? 0.004;
  const skip = (c: Component) => c.method.kind === "grow" || (o.skip?.(c) ?? false);
  const solids = components.filter((c) => !skip(c)).map((c) => {
    const bs = boxesOf(c).map((b) => toWorld(c, b));
    const env = { min: [0, 1, 2].map((k) => Math.min(...bs.map((b) => b.min[k]))), max: [0, 1, 2].map((k) => Math.max(...bs.map((b) => b.max[k]))) };
    return { c, bs, env, s: timeline.get(c.id)! };
  });
  const hit = (a: Box, b: Box) => [0, 1, 2].every((k) => Math.min(a.max[k], b.max[k]) - Math.max(a.min[k], b.min[k]) > EPS);
  const clashes: string[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < solids.length; i++)
    for (let j = i + 1; j < solids.length; j++) {
      const A = solids[i], B = solids[j];
      const aOut = A.s.out?.[1] ?? Infinity, bOut = B.s.out?.[1] ?? Infinity;
      if (A.s.start >= bOut || B.s.start >= aOut || !hit(A.env, B.env)) continue;
      const pair = A.bs.flatMap((a) => B.bs.filter((b) => hit(a, b)).map((b) => [a, b] as const))[0];
      if (pair) {
        const ov = [0, 1, 2].map((k) => Math.min(pair[0].max[k], pair[1].max[k]) - Math.max(pair[0].min[k], pair[1].min[k]));
        clashes.push(`${A.c.id} × ${B.c.id}  overlap ${ov.map((v) => v.toFixed(3)).join(" ")} at ${pair[0].min.map((v) => v.toFixed(2)).join(",")}`);
      }
    }
  const late = components.filter((c) => timeline.get(c.id)!.end > o.end).map((c) => c.id);
  return { ok: !order.length && !clashes.length && !late.length, components: components.length, timeline, order, clashes, late };
};

export const report = (id: string, r: CheckResult, windows: number) => {
  console.log(`[${id}] ${r.components} components, ${windows} phases`);
  for (const i of r.order) console.log(`order: ${i}`);
  for (const c of r.clashes.slice(0, 40)) console.log(`clash ${c}`);
  if (r.late.length) console.log(`finishes after the end: ${r.late.join(", ")}`);
  console.log(r.ok ? `[${id}] OK: sequence is physically ordered, no clashes, finishes in time` : `[${id}] FAIL: ${r.order.length} order issues, ${r.clashes.length} clashes, ${r.late.length} late`);
  return r.ok;
};

==== 4130 src/kits/buildforge/assembly/motion.ts
// Construction timeline evaluation: given a component, its slot and the frame, where is it
// and what does it look like. Pure functions of the frame number, so renders are
// deterministic and any frame can be rendered alone.

import { bezier, ease, remap } from "../motion/easing.ts";
import type { Slot } from "./schedule.ts";
import type { Component, Vec3 } from "../types.ts";

export type RigState = { kind: "single" | "sling" | "four"; lift: number; alpha: number };

export type CompState = {
  visible: boolean;
  /** Linear progress of the arrival (reversed while leaving). */
  lin: number;
  /** Eased progress for methods the renderer completes (spread, coat). */
  u: number;
  offset: Vec3;
  scale: Vec3;
  yaw: number;
  opacity: number;
  /** Fresh concrete: 1 just poured, 0 cured. */
  wet: number;
  ghost: number;
  rig: RigState | null;
};

/** Crane set-down: steady descent, very long soft landing. */
const craneDown = bezier(0.38, 0, 0.1, 1);
const install = bezier(0.3, 0, 0.12, 1);
export const RIG_LIFT = 11;
export const GHOST_LEAD = 14;
const CURE = 45;

export const stateOf = (c: Component, slot: Slot, f: number): CompState => {
  const m = c.method;
  let lin = remap(f, slot.start, slot.end);
  const leaving = slot.out && f > slot.out[0] ? remap(f, slot.out[0], slot.out[1]) : 0;
  if (leaving > 0) lin = 1 - leaving;
  const gone = slot.out !== undefined && f >= slot.out[1];
  const s: CompState = {
    visible: f > slot.start && !gone,
    lin,
    u: lin,
    offset: [0, 0, 0],
    scale: [1, 1, 1],
    yaw: 0,
    opacity: 1,
    wet: 0,
    ghost: 0,
    rig: null,
  };
  const cure = () => (f < slot.start ? 0 : 1 - remap(f, slot.end, slot.end + CURE));

  switch (m.kind) {
    case "lower": {
      const u = craneDown(lin);
      // a suspended load swings a little and settles as it is guided onto its seat
      const swing = (1 - lin) ** 2;
      s.offset = [0.08 * Math.sin(lin * 9) * swing, m.height * (1 - u), 0.06 * Math.sin(lin * 7 + 1) * swing];
      s.yaw = 0.05 * Math.sin(lin * 6.5) * swing;
      s.opacity = remap(lin, 0, 0.1);
      if (leaving > 0) s.rig = { kind: m.rig, lift: 0, alpha: s.opacity };
      else if (f > slot.start && f < slot.end + RIG_LIFT) {
        const lift = remap(f, slot.end, slot.end + RIG_LIFT);
        s.rig = { kind: m.rig, lift: ease.in(lift), alpha: s.opacity * (1 - remap(lift, 0.25, 1)) };
      }
      break;
    }
    case "slide": {
      const u = install(lin);
      s.offset = [m.from[0] * (1 - u), m.from[1] * (1 - u), m.from[2] * (1 - u)];
      s.opacity = remap(lin, 0, 0.25);
      break;
    }
    case "fill":
      s.u = ease.inOut(lin);
      s.scale = [1, Math.max(1e-3, s.u), 1];
      if (m.cure) s.wet = cure();
      break;
    case "spread":
      s.u = ease.sine(lin);
      if (m.cure) s.wet = cure();
      break;
    case "drive": {
      // carried in and stood up (first 30 %), then three blows
      const carry = remap(lin, 0, 0.3);
      const k = remap(lin, 0.3, 1) * 3;
      const blows = (Math.min(2, Math.floor(k)) + ease.out(remap(k - Math.min(2, Math.floor(k)), 0, 0.35))) / 3;
      s.offset = [0, m.depth * (1 - blows) + 0.5 * (1 - ease.out(carry)), 0];
      s.opacity = remap(lin, 0, 0.15);
      break;
    }
    case "draw":
      s.scale = [Math.max(1e-3, ease.inOut(lin)), 1, 1];
      break;
    case "grow": {
      const g = 0.04 + 0.96 * ease.release(lin);
      s.scale = [g, g, g];
      s.opacity = remap(lin, 0, 0.12);
      break;
    }
    case "coat":
      s.u = ease.inOut(lin);
      break;
    case "lay":
      break;
  }
  if (leaving > 0) s.opacity *= 1 - remap(leaving, 0.7, 1);
  const ghosted = c.ghost ?? !["drive", "draw", "grow"].includes(m.kind);
  if (ghosted && leaving === 0) s.ghost = remap(f, slot.start - GHOST_LEAD, slot.start) * (1 - remap(lin, 0.55, 0.97));
  return s;
};

/** Per-piece move inside a "lay" component: returns local progress (0 hidden … 1 seated). */
export const pieceProgress = (i: number, n: number, lin: number, each: number) => {
  const t0 = n > 1 ? (i / (n - 1)) * (1 - each) : 0;
  return remap(lin, t0, t0 + each);
};

==== 3418 src/kits/buildforge/assembly/schedule.ts
// Assembly sequence → construction timeline. Each phase gets a window on the film clock; the
// components of a phase are staggered across it by key. `validate` enforces the physical
// rule: nothing starts before everything it bears on is in place, and temporary works are
// not removed while something still bears on them.

import type { Component } from "../types.ts";

export type PhaseWindow = {
  phase: string;
  start: number;
  end: number;
  /** Frames one component's move takes inside the window. */
  dur: number;
};

export type Slot = { start: number; end: number; out?: [number, number] };
export type Timeline = Map<string, Slot>;

const placeIn = (w: PhaseWindow, members: Component[], set: (c: Component, a: number, b: number) => void) => {
  const keyOf = (c: Component, i: number) => c.key ?? i;
  const keys = [...new Set(members.map(keyOf))].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const span = Math.max(0, w.end - w.dur - w.start);
  members.forEach((c, i) => {
    const r = keys.indexOf(keyOf(c, i));
    const a = keys.length > 1 ? w.start + (span * r) / (keys.length - 1) : w.start;
    set(c, a, a + w.dur);
  });
};

export const schedule = (components: Component[], windows: PhaseWindow[]): Timeline => {
  const win = new Map(windows.map((w) => [w.phase, w]));
  const get = (phase: string) => {
    const w = win.get(phase);
    if (!w) throw new Error(`BUILDFORGE: no window for phase "${phase}"`);
    if (w.dur > w.end - w.start) throw new Error(`BUILDFORGE: phase "${phase}" dur ${w.dur} exceeds its window`);
    return w;
  };
  const slots: Timeline = new Map();
  const group = (by: (c: Component) => string | undefined) => {
    const m = new Map<string, Component[]>();
    for (const c of components) {
      const k = by(c);
      if (k) m.set(k, [...(m.get(k) ?? []), c]);
    }
    return m;
  };
  for (const [phase, members] of group((c) => c.phase)) placeIn(get(phase), members, (c, a, b) => slots.set(c.id, { start: a, end: b }));
  for (const [phase, members] of group((c) => c.exit)) placeIn(get(phase), members, (c, a, b) => (slots.get(c.id)!.out = [a, b]));
  return slots;
};

export const validate = (components: Component[], slots: Timeline) => {
  const issues: string[] = [];
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  for (const c of components) {
    if (seen.has(c.id)) issues.push(`duplicate id ${c.id}`);
    seen.add(c.id);
  }
  for (const c of components) {
    const s = slots.get(c.id)!;
    for (const r of c.rests ?? []) {
      const t = slots.get(r);
      if (!t) issues.push(`${c.id}: rests on unknown "${r}"`);
      else {
        if (t.end > s.start + 1e-6) issues.push(`${c.id} starts at ${s.start.toFixed(1)} before its support ${r} is in place (${t.end.toFixed(1)})`);
        if (t.out && t.out[0] < (s.out ? s.out[1] : Infinity)) issues.push(`${r} is removed while ${c.id} still bears on it`);
      }
    }
    for (const r of c.after ?? []) {
      const t = slots.get(r);
      if (!t) issues.push(`${c.id}: comes after unknown "${r}"`);
      else if (t.end > s.start + 1e-6) issues.push(`${c.id} starts at ${s.start.toFixed(1)} before ${r} is done (${t.end.toFixed(1)})`);
    }
  }
  return issues;
};

/** Frame at which the last component of a phase is in place. */
export const phaseEnd = (components: Component[], slots: Timeline, phase: string) =>
  Math.max(...components.filter((c) => c.phase === phase).map((c) => slots.get(c.id)!.end));

==== 885 src/kits/buildforge/camera/director.ts
// Camera director: a spherical rig (target, azimuth, elevation, distance, fov) sampled from
// C1 keyframe tracks, so moves hand over without kinks and nothing depends on wall time.

import { sample, type Key } from "../motion/track.ts";
import type { Shot } from "../render/Post.tsx";

const D = Math.PI / 180;

/** Track channels: [targetX, targetY, targetZ, azimuthDeg, elevationDeg, distance, fovDeg]. */
export type RigKeys = Key[];

export const shotAt = (rig: RigKeys, frame: number, lens: { aperture: number; maxBlur: number; exposure: number }): Shot => {
  const [tx, ty, tz, az, el, dist, fov] = sample(rig, frame);
  const pos: [number, number, number] = [
    tx + dist * Math.cos(el * D) * Math.sin(az * D),
    ty + dist * Math.sin(el * D),
    tz + dist * Math.cos(el * D) * Math.cos(az * D),
  ];
  return { pos, target: [tx, ty, tz], fov, focus: dist, ...lens };
};

==== 3706 src/kits/buildforge/environment/Sky.ts
// Daylight sky: soft blue zenith, warm-white haze at the horizon, a sun glow, static cloud
// layer (uShift drifts it for time-lapses). The same dome is rendered once into a PMREM so
// glass and metal reflect the sky the camera sees.

import { BackSide, Color, Mesh, PMREMGenerator, Scene, ShaderMaterial, SphereGeometry, Vector2, type Vector3, type WebGLRenderer, CircleGeometry, MeshBasicMaterial } from "three";

export type SkyLook = { zenith: string; horizon: string; ground: string; sun: string; cloud: string };

export const skyMaterial = (look: SkyLook, sunDir: Vector3) =>
  new ShaderMaterial({
    side: BackSide,
    depthWrite: false,
    fog: false,
    uniforms: {
      uZenith: { value: new Color(look.zenith) },
      uHorizon: { value: new Color(look.horizon) },
      uGround: { value: new Color(look.ground) },
      uSun: { value: new Color(look.sun) },
      uCloud: { value: new Color(look.cloud) },
      uSunDir: { value: sunDir.clone().normalize() },
      uShift: { value: new Vector2() },
    },
    vertexShader: /* glsl */ `
      varying vec3 vDir;
      void main(){
        vec4 w = modelMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
        vDir = w.xyz - cameraPosition;
        gl_Position = projectionMatrix * viewMatrix * w;
      }`,
    fragmentShader: /* glsl */ `
      uniform vec3 uZenith; uniform vec3 uHorizon; uniform vec3 uGround; uniform vec3 uSun; uniform vec3 uSunDir; uniform vec3 uCloud; uniform vec2 uShift;
      varying vec3 vDir;
      float hash(vec2 p){ return fract(sin(dot(p, vec2(127.1, 311.7))) * 43758.5453); }
      float vnoise(vec2 p){
        vec2 i = floor(p), f = fract(p); f = f * f * (3.0 - 2.0 * f);
        return mix(mix(hash(i), hash(i + vec2(1.0, 0.0)), f.x), mix(hash(i + vec2(0.0, 1.0)), hash(i + vec2(1.0, 1.0)), f.x), f.y);
      }
      float fbm(vec2 p){ float s = 0.0, a = 0.5; for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++){ s += a * vnoise(p); p = p * 2.03 + 7.1; a *= 0.5; } return s; }
      void main(){
        vec3 d = normalize(vDir);
        float y = d.y;
        vec3 c = mix(uHorizon, uZenith, pow(smoothstep(0.0, 0.65, y), 0.5));
        c = mix(c, uGround, smoothstep(0.0, -0.12, y));
        // soft fair-weather clouds on a flat layer (static: the sky never flickers)
        if (y > 0.0) {
          vec2 uv = d.xz / (y + 0.1) * 0.9 + vec2(4.0, 2.0) + uShift;
          float cl = smoothstep(0.46, 0.8, fbm(uv)) * smoothstep(0.015, 0.1, y) * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.55, 0.9, y));
          // lit tops, softly shaded undersides
          vec3 cc = mix(uCloud * 0.86, uCloud, smoothstep(0.5, 0.75, fbm(uv + vec2(0.05, 0.12))));
          c = mix(c, cc, cl * 0.85);
        }
        float s = max(dot(d, normalize(uSunDir)), 0.0);
        c += uSun * (pow(s, 5.0) * 0.16 + pow(s, 60.0) * 0.3 + smoothstep(0.99955, 0.9998, s) * 5.0);
        gl_FragColor = vec4(c, 1.0);
      }`,
  });

export const createSky = (look: SkyLook, sunDir: Vector3, radius = 1800) => {
  const m = new Mesh(new SphereGeometry(radius, 64, 32), skyMaterial(look, sunDir));
  m.frustumCulled = false;
  m.renderOrder = -10;
  return m;
};

/** Environment map from the sky dome plus a sunlit ground disc (what a facade "sees"). */
export const skyEnvironment = (gl: WebGLRenderer, look: SkyLook, sunDir: Vector3) => {
  const scene = new Scene();
  scene.add(new Mesh(new SphereGeometry(50, 48, 24), skyMaterial(look, sunDir)));
  const ground = new Mesh(new CircleGeometry(49, 48), new MeshBasicMaterial({ color: new Color(look.ground).multiplyScalar(0.85) }));
  ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
  ground.position.y = -1.5;
  scene.add(ground);
  const pm = new PMREMGenerator(gl);
  const rt = pm.fromScene(scene, 0.02);
  pm.dispose();
  return rt.texture;
};

==== 9636 src/kits/buildforge/environment/Terrain.ts
// The ground as a construction surface. Natural relief (contours, distant hills) → site
// grading → excavation advancing behind a digging front → backfill → lawn spreading out from
// the building. One height/colour field, evaluated on a grid that is fine on the site and has
// grid lines on every cut edge so excavation walls are crisp.

import { BufferAttribute, BufferGeometry, Color, Mesh, MeshStandardMaterial } from "three";
import { fbm2 } from "../geometry/noise.ts";
import { clamp, smoothstep } from "../motion/easing.ts";

export type Area = { x0: number; x1: number; z0: number; z1: number };

export type SiteSpec = {
  /** Area levelled before construction. */
  site: Area;
  /** Excavation and its depth. */
  pit: Area;
  depth: number;
  /** Footprint that stays excavated under the slab after backfill. */
  slab: Area;
  /** Planting beds (dark soil) and the decorative gravel strip around the building. */
  beds: Area[];
  gravelBand: number;
};

export type TerrainState = { contour: number; grade: number; dig: number; backfill: number; lawn: number };

export type GroundLook = { meadow: string; meadowDry: string; soil: string; dug: string; lawn: string; lawnDeep: string; gravel: string; bed: string };

const edge = (x: number, z: number, a: Area) => Math.min(x - a.x0, a.x1 - x, z - a.z0, a.z1 - z);
const inside = (x: number, z: number, a: Area) => edge(x, z, a) >= 0;
/** Distance from a point outside a rectangle to it (0 inside). */
const outDist = (x: number, z: number, a: Area) => Math.hypot(Math.max(a.x0 - x, 0, x - a.x1), Math.max(a.z0 - z, 0, z - a.z1));

export const naturalHeight = (x: number, z: number) => {
  const r = Math.hypot(x, z);
  let h = 0.55 * fbm2(x * 0.03 + 3.1, z * 0.03 - 2.2, 3) + 0.2 * fbm2(x * 0.11, z * 0.11, 2);
  h += 3.2 * smoothstep((r - 30) / 90) * fbm2(x * 0.014 + 1.7, z * 0.014 + 4.2, 3);
  h += 34 * smoothstep((r - 140) / 260) * (0.5 + fbm2(x * 0.0045 + 7, z * 0.0045 + 1, 3));
  return h;
};
const H0 = naturalHeight(0, 0);

const axis = (inner: number, step: number, outer: number, extra: number[]) => {
  const v: number[] = [];
  for (let x = -inner; x <= inner + 1e-6; x += step) v.push(x);
  for (let s = step, x = inner; x < outer; ) {
    s *= 1.14;
    x += s;
    v.push(x, -x);
  }
  v.push(...extra);
  v.sort((a, b) => a - b);
  return v.filter((x, i) => i === 0 || x - v[i - 1] > 0.004);
};

export class Terrain {
  readonly mesh: Mesh;
  private xs: number[];
  private zs: number[];
  private col: Float32Array;
  private pos: Float32Array;
  private key = "";
  private look: Record<keyof GroundLook, Color>;
  /** Cached per-vertex natural height and colour noise (they never change). */
  private nat: Float32Array;
  private nv: Float32Array;
  private nv2: Float32Array;

  private spec: SiteSpec;

  constructor(spec: SiteSpec, look: GroundLook, inner = 30, outer = 900) {
    this.spec = spec;
    const cuts = (a: Area, k: "x" | "z") => (k === "x" ? [a.x0, a.x1] : [a.z0, a.z1]).flatMap((v) => [v - 0.025, v, v + 0.025]);
    const areas = [spec.pit, spec.slab, ...spec.beds, { x0: spec.slab.x0 - spec.gravelBand, x1: spec.slab.x1 + spec.gravelBand, z0: spec.slab.z0 - spec.gravelBand, z1: spec.slab.z1 + spec.gravelBand }];
    this.xs = axis(inner, 0.3, outer, areas.flatMap((a) => cuts(a, "x")));
    this.zs = axis(inner, 0.3, outer, areas.flatMap((a) => cuts(a, "z")));
    const nx = this.xs.length, nz = this.zs.length;
    this.pos = new Float32Array(nx * nz * 3);
    this.col = new Float32Array(nx * nz * 3);
    this.nat = new Float32Array(nx * nz);
    this.nv = new Float32Array(nx * nz);
    this.nv2 = new Float32Array(nx * nz);
    this.zs.forEach((z, j) =>
      this.xs.forEach((x, i) => {
        this.nat[j * nx + i] = naturalHeight(x, z) - H0;
        this.nv[j * nx + i] = fbm2(x * 0.35, z * 0.35, 2);
        this.nv2[j * nx + i] = fbm2(x * 0.06 + 9, z * 0.06, 2);
      }),
    );
    const idx = new Uint32Array((nx - 1) * (nz - 1) * 6);
    let k = 0;
    for (let j = 0; j < nz - 1; j++)
      for (let i = 0; i < nx - 1; i++) {
        const a = j * nx + i, b = a + 1, c = a + nx, d = c + 1;
        idx.set([a, c, b, b, c, d], k);
        k += 6;
      }
    const g = new BufferGeometry();
    g.setAttribute("position", new BufferAttribute(this.pos, 3));
    g.setAttribute("color", new BufferAttribute(this.col, 3));
    g.setIndex(new BufferAttribute(idx, 1));
    this.look = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(look).map(([k2, v]) => [k2, new Color(v)])) as Record<keyof GroundLook, Color>;
    const mat = new MeshStandardMaterial({ vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.97, metalness: 0 });
    const contour = { value: 0 };
    mat.onBeforeCompile = (s) => {
      s.uniforms.uContour = contour;
      s.vertexShader = s.vertexShader
        .replace("#include <common>", "#include <common>\nvarying vec3 vTw;")
        .replace("#include <project_vertex>", "#include <project_vertex>\nvTw = (modelMatrix * vec4(transformed, 1.0)).xyz;");
      s.fragmentShader = s.fragmentShader.replace("#include <common>", /* glsl */ `#include <common>
        varying vec3 vTw; uniform float uContour;
        float th(vec2 p){ return fract(sin(dot(p, vec2(127.1, 311.7))) * 43758.5453); }
        float tn(vec2 p){ vec2 i = floor(p), f = fract(p); f = f * f * (3.0 - 2.0 * f);
          return mix(mix(th(i), th(i + vec2(1.0, 0.0)), f.x), mix(th(i + vec2(0.0, 1.0)), th(i + vec2(1.0, 1.0)), f.x), f.y); }`).replace(
        "#include <color_fragment>",
        /* glsl */ `#include <color_fragment>
        {
          // fine ground texture (grass tufts, soil grain) below the vertex-colour resolution
          float fine = tn(vTw.xz * 2.7) * 0.55 + tn(vTw.xz * 9.0) * 0.3 + tn(vTw.xz * 31.0) * 0.15;
          diffuseColor.rgb *= 0.9 + 0.2 * fine;
        }
        {
          // survey contours every 0.25 m (every metre stronger), only near the site
          float hh = (vTw.y - 0.125) / 0.25;
          float w = max(fwidth(hh), 1e-4);
          float minor = 1.0 - min(abs(fract(hh - 0.5) - 0.5) / (w * 1.1), 1.0);
          float hm = (vTw.y - 0.125) / 1.0;
          float wm = max(fwidth(hm), 1e-4);
          float major = 1.0 - min(abs(fract(hm - 0.5) - 0.5) / (wm * 1.6), 1.0);
          float near = 1.0 - smoothstep(35.0, 110.0, length(vTw.xz));
          float l = max(minor * 0.6, major) * near * uContour;
          diffuseColor.rgb = mix(diffuseColor.rgb, vec3(0.96, 1.0, 0.97), l * 0.85);
        }`,
      );
    };
    mat.userData.contour = contour;
    this.mesh = new Mesh(g, mat);
    this.mesh.receiveShadow = true;
    this.mesh.frustumCulled = false;
  }

  /** Height of the ground for a given construction state. */
  height(x: number, z: number, st: TerrainState, n = naturalHeight(x, z) - H0) {
    const sp = this.spec;
    const graded = this.graded(x, z, st.grade);
    let h = n * (1 - graded);
    if (inside(x, z, sp.pit)) {
      const front = sp.pit.x0 - 0.6 + (sp.pit.x1 - sp.pit.x0 + 1.2) * st.dig;
      let d = sp.depth * clamp((front - x) / 0.6);
      if (!inside(x, z, sp.slab)) d *= 1 - st.backfill;
      h -= d;
    }
    return h;
  }

  private graded(x: number, z: number, grade: number) {
    const s = this.spec.site;
    const mask = smoothstep((edge(x, z, s) + 5) / 5);
    const w = s.x1 - s.x0 + 22;
    const local = clamp((grade * (w + 9) - (x - s.x0 + 11)) / 9);
    return mask * local;
  }

  update(st: TerrainState) {
    (this.mesh.material as MeshStandardMaterial).userData.contour.value = st.contour;
    const key = [st.grade, st.dig, st.backfill, st.lawn].map((v) => v.toFixed(4)).join("|");
    if (key === this.key) return;
    this.key = key;
    const sp = this.spec, L = this.look, nx = this.xs.length;
    const c = new Color();
    const band = { x0: sp.slab.x0 - sp.gravelBand, x1: sp.slab.x1 + sp.gravelBand, z0: sp.slab.z0 - sp.gravelBand, z1: sp.slab.z1 + sp.gravelBand };
    this.zs.forEach((z, j) =>
      this.xs.forEach((x, i) => {
        const vi = j * nx + i, k = vi * 3;
        const h = this.height(x, z, st, this.nat[vi]);
        this.pos[k] = x;
        this.pos[k + 1] = h;
        this.pos[k + 2] = z;
        const v = this.nv[vi], v2 = this.nv2[vi];
        c.copy(L.meadow).lerp(L.meadowDry, clamp(0.5 + v2 * 1.6)).multiplyScalar(0.94 + v * 0.22);
        const cleared = smoothstep(this.graded(x, z, Math.min(1, st.grade * 1.15)) * 1.4);
        c.lerp(L.soil.clone().multiplyScalar(0.9 + v * 0.35 + v2 * 0.1), cleared * 0.92);
        if (inside(x, z, sp.pit)) {
          c.lerp(L.dug, smoothstep(clamp(-h / sp.depth) * 3));
        }
        if (st.lawn > 0) {
          const site = smoothstep((edge(x, z, sp.site) + 5) / 5);
          const dist = outDist(x, z, sp.slab);
          const reach = smoothstep(clamp((st.lawn * 34 - dist) / 3));
          if (inside(x, z, band)) c.lerp(L.gravel, reach);
          else if (sp.beds.some((b) => inside(x, z, b))) c.lerp(L.bed, reach);
          else {
            // mown lawn: soft alternating stripes along the facade, plus natural patchiness
            const stripe = smoothstep((Math.sin((x * Math.PI) / 1.4) + 0.3) / 0.6);
            const lawn = L.lawn.clone().lerp(L.lawnDeep, clamp(0.5 + v * 2.2)).multiplyScalar(0.95 + v2 * 0.12 + stripe * 0.05);
            // outside the site the lawn feathers into the meadow
            c.lerp(lawn, reach * site);
          }
        }
        this.col[k] = c.r;
        this.col[k + 1] = c.g;
        this.col[k + 2] = c.b;
      }),
    );
    const g = this.mesh.geometry;
    g.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true;
    g.attributes.color.needsUpdate = true;
    g.computeVertexNormals();
  }
}

==== 6210 src/kits/buildforge/environment/Vegetation.ts
// Planting geometry: trees and shrubs as soft, irregular foliage masses (noise-displaced
// clusters with per-vertex colour: darker and cooler underneath, lighter where the sun hits).
// Origin at the base, so "grow" scales them up out of the ground.

import { BoxGeometry, BufferAttribute, CylinderGeometry, IcosahedronGeometry, type BufferGeometry, Color, Vector3 } from "three";
import { mergeGeometries, mergeVertices } from "three/examples/jsm/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js";
import { noise3, rng } from "../geometry/noise.ts";
import type { SubMesh } from "../types.ts";

export type Palette = { low: string; mid: string; high: string };

const blob = (r: number, cx: number, cy: number, cz: number, seed: number, stretchY = 1, detail = 3) => {
  const ico = new IcosahedronGeometry(r, detail);
  ico.deleteAttribute("normal");
  ico.deleteAttribute("uv");
  // shared vertices → smooth normals after displacement (no faceted "low-poly toy" look)
  const g = mergeVertices(ico);
  const p = g.attributes.position;
  for (let i = 0; i < p.count; i++) {
    const x = p.getX(i), y = p.getY(i), z = p.getZ(i);
    const k = 1 + 0.34 * noise3(x * 1.6 / r + seed, y * 1.6 / r, z * 1.6 / r) + 0.16 * noise3(x * 5 / r, y * 5 / r + seed, z * 5 / r) + 0.07 * noise3(x * 13 / r + seed, y * 13 / r, z * 13 / r);
    p.setXYZ(i, cx + x * k, cy + y * k * stretchY, cz + z * k);
  }
  return g;
};

const merge = (gs: BufferGeometry[]) => mergeGeometries(gs, false)!;

const paint = (g: BufferGeometry, pal: Palette, y0: number, y1: number, seed: number) => {
  const lo = new Color(pal.low), mid = new Color(pal.mid), hi = new Color(pal.high), c = new Color();
  const p = g.attributes.position;
  const col = new Float32Array(p.count * 3);
  for (let i = 0; i < p.count; i++) {
    const t = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (p.getY(i) - y0) / (y1 - y0)));
    const n = noise3(p.getX(i) * 0.9 + seed, p.getY(i) * 0.9, p.getZ(i) * 0.9);
    c.copy(lo).lerp(mid, Math.min(1, t * 1.6)).lerp(hi, Math.max(0, t - 0.55) * 1.6).multiplyScalar(0.92 + n * 0.3);
    col.set([c.r, c.g, c.b], i * 3);
  }
  g.setAttribute("color", new BufferAttribute(col, 3));
  g.computeVertexNormals();
  return g;
};

/**
 * Deciduous tree, `h` metres tall: a forked trunk under a crown built from many leaf masses.
 * `spread` > 1 flattens and widens the crown (open-grown shade trees).
 */
export const roundTree = (h: number, seed: number, pal: Palette, spread = 1): SubMesh[] => {
  const r = rng(seed);
  const trunkH = h * 0.4;
  const trunk = new CylinderGeometry(h * 0.016, h * 0.028, trunkH, 7);
  trunk.translate(0, trunkH / 2, 0);
  const crownR = h * 0.31, cy = trunkH + crownR * 0.7;
  const limbs = [trunk];
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    const a = (i / 3) * Math.PI * 2 + r(), len = crownR * 0.9;
    const limb = new CylinderGeometry(h * 0.006, h * 0.012, len, 5);
    limb.translate(0, len / 2, 0);
    limb.rotateZ(0.65);
    limb.rotateY(a);
    limb.translate(0, trunkH * 0.88, 0);
    limbs.push(limb);
  }
  const masses = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 22; i++) {
    // leaf masses fill an ellipsoid, the outer ones smaller so the silhouette breaks up
    const a = r() * Math.PI * 2, u = r() * 2 - 1, d = Math.cbrt(0.25 + r() * 0.75);
    const x = Math.cos(a) * Math.sqrt(1 - u * u) * d, y = u * d, z = Math.sin(a) * Math.sqrt(1 - u * u) * d;
    const rr = crownR * (0.44 - d * 0.17) * (0.8 + r() * 0.4);
    masses.push(blob(rr * (0.85 + 0.15 * spread), x * crownR * 0.8 * spread, cy + (y * crownR * 0.6) / spread, z * crownR * 0.8 * spread, seed * 7 + i, 0.88 / spread, 2));
  }
  const crown = paint(merge(masses), pal, cy - crownR * 0.8, cy + crownR * 0.9, seed);
  return [{ geom: mergeGeometries(limbs.map((g) => g.toNonIndexed()))!, material: "bark" }, { geom: crown, material: "foliage" }];
};

/** Slender columnar tree (garden accent): stacked leaf masses on a short trunk. */
export const columnTree = (h: number, seed: number, pal: Palette): SubMesh[] => {
  const r = rng(seed);
  const trunk = new CylinderGeometry(h * 0.01, h * 0.018, h * 0.3, 6);
  trunk.translate(0, h * 0.15, 0);
  const masses = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
    const t = i / 8, y = h * (0.26 + t * 0.62), w = h * 0.11 * Math.sin(Math.PI * (0.12 + t * 0.82));
    const a = r() * 6.28;
    masses.push(blob(w * (0.8 + r() * 0.3), Math.cos(a) * w * 0.25, y, Math.sin(a) * w * 0.25, seed * 5 + i, 1.25, 2));
  }
  return [{ geom: trunk, material: "bark" }, { geom: paint(merge(masses), pal, h * 0.2, h, seed), material: "foliage" }];
};

/** Low shrub clump of `n` rounded masses within radius `r`. */
export const shrub = (r: number, seed: number, pal: Palette, n = 5): SubMesh[] => {
  const q = rng(seed);
  const parts = Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => {
    const a = (i / n) * Math.PI * 2 + q(), d = i === 0 ? 0 : r * 0.5;
    const rr = r * (i === 0 ? 0.62 : 0.42 + q() * 0.2);
    return blob(rr, Math.cos(a) * d, rr * 0.75, Math.sin(a) * d, seed + i, 0.85, 2);
  });
  return [{ geom: paint(merge(parts), pal, 0, r * 1.4, seed), material: "foliage" }];
};

/** Clipped hedge: a rounded box with a leafy, slightly uneven surface. Origin at the base centre. */
export const hedge = (len: number, h: number, d: number, seed: number, pal: Palette): SubMesh[] => {
  const box = new BoxGeometry(len, h, d, Math.ceil(len * 6), Math.ceil(h * 6), Math.ceil(d * 6));
  box.deleteAttribute("normal");
  box.deleteAttribute("uv");
  const g = mergeVertices(box);
  const p = g.attributes.position;
  const half = new Vector3(len / 2, h / 2, d / 2), r = Math.min(h, d) * 0.16;
  const v = new Vector3(), q = new Vector3(), n = new Vector3();
  for (let i = 0; i < p.count; i++) {
    v.fromBufferAttribute(p, i);
    q.set(Math.max(-half.x + r, Math.min(half.x - r, v.x)), Math.max(-half.y + r, Math.min(half.y - r, v.y)), Math.max(-half.z + r, Math.min(half.z - r, v.z)));
    n.subVectors(v, q);
    if (n.lengthSq() < 1e-9) continue;
    n.normalize();
    const k = r + 0.05 * noise3(v.x * 3 + seed, v.y * 3, v.z * 3) + 0.035 * noise3(v.x * 9, v.y * 9 + seed, v.z * 9);
    v.copy(q).addScaledVector(n, k);
    p.setXYZ(i, v.x, v.y + h / 2, v.z);
  }
  return [{ geom: paint(g, pal, 0, h, seed), material: "foliage" }];
};

==== 3001 src/kits/buildforge/example/BuildforgeExample.tsx
// BUILDFORGE technical example — a garden pavilion assembled piece by piece in true 3D (10 s at any fps).
// World, construction clock, camera rig, finishing chain and stage labels, all from src/kits/buildforge.
// It is a technical check and a starting point, not a story: never reuse it as a buyer's film.

import React, { useLayoutEffect, useMemo } from "react";
import { AbsoluteFill, useCurrentFrame, useVideoConfig } from "remotion";
import { ThreeCanvas } from "@remotion/three";
import { useThree } from "@react-three/fiber";
import { PCFShadowMap } from "three";
import { FONT } from "../../../core/type/fonts.ts";
import { shotAt } from "../camera/director.ts";
import { StageLabel } from "../labels/StageLabel.tsx";
import { CameraRig, Post } from "../render/Post.tsx";
import { createWorld, sunLook } from "../world/createWorld.ts";
import { SITE, pavilionComponents } from "./pavilion.ts";
import { CLOCK, EXAMPLE_SECONDS, LENS, RIG, STAGES_S, WINDOWS, terrainAt } from "./sequence.ts";

export const BUILDFORGE_EXAMPLE_SECONDS = EXAMPLE_SECONDS;

const SUN: [number, number, number] = [-0.55, 0.62, 0.56];
const DAYLIGHT = sunLook(SUN);

/** Trees already standing around the site: [x, z, height]. Keep the camera's final view clear. */
const WILD: [number, number, number][] = [
  [-11, -16, 8], [-2, -19, 9], [8, -17, 7.5], [16, -14, 8.5], [-19, -12, 7], [21, -2, 8], [-22, 3, 7.5], [24, 9, 9],
];

const World: React.FC<{ frame: number; fps: number }> = ({ frame, fps }) => {
  const { gl, scene } = useThree();
  const world = useMemo(
    () =>
      createWorld(gl, scene, {
        components: pavilionComponents(),
        windows: WINDOWS,
        site: SITE,
        terrainAt,
        trees: WILD,
        sunDir: SUN,
        shadowSize: 22,
      }),
    [gl, scene],
  );
  // construction clock: CLOCK units per second, whatever the render fps
  const c = (frame / fps) * CLOCK;
  useLayoutEffect(() => world.update(c, DAYLIGHT), [world, c]);
  const shot = useMemo(() => shotAt(RIG, c, LENS), [c]);
  return (
    <>
      <primitive object={world.root} />
      <CameraRig shot={shot} />
      <Post shot={shot} frame={frame} aoRadius={0.45} />
    </>
  );
};

export const BuildforgeExample: React.FC = () => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const { fps, width, height } = useVideoConfig();
  const stages = STAGES_S.map((s) => ({ ...s, from: Math.round(s.from * fps), to: Math.round(s.to * fps) }));
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ backgroundColor: "#e8eef0" }}>
      <ThreeCanvas width={width} height={height} shadows={{ type: PCFShadowMap }} dpr={1}
        gl={{ antialias: false, preserveDrawingBuffer: true, powerPreference: "high-performance" }}
        camera={{ fov: 36, near: 0.4, far: 2500, position: [0, 10, 40] }}>
        <World frame={frame} fps={fps} />
      </ThreeCanvas>
      <StageLabel stages={stages} frame={frame} fps={fps} width={width} font={FONT} ink="#22292c" soft="#5f6b70" accent="#1fae95" />
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

==== 12199 src/kits/buildforge/example/pavilion.ts
// BUILDFORGE technical example: a small steel-and-timber garden pavilion (6 × 4 m), built in the order a
// real crew would: set-out → excavation → pad footings → formwork → slab pour → steel columns → beams →
// timber roof boards → roof cap → back glazing → slatted side screen → bench → path → planting.
// It is a technical check and a starting point, not a story: never reuse it as a buyer's film.
//
// Every component has a seat, a placement method and what it bears on; timing lives in sequence.ts.

import { glazing } from "../geometry/openings.ts";
import { box, cast, merge, sub } from "../geometry/shapes.ts";
import { columnTree, roundTree, shrub } from "../environment/Vegetation.ts";
import type { SiteSpec } from "../environment/Terrain.ts";
import type { Component, Method, Piece, Vec3 } from "../types.ts";
import { LEAF } from "../presets/daylight.ts";

/* ───────────────────────── plan (metres) ───────────────────────── */

export const XS = [-3, 0, 3];
export const ZS = [-2, 2];
const HC = 0.08; // half column
export const LV = { pit: -0.4, footingTop: -0.12, slabBottom: -0.12, floor: 0.18, colTop: 3.0, beamTop: 3.24, boardsTop: 3.29, capTop: 3.4 };
export const SLAB = { x0: -3.5, x1: 3.5, z0: -2.5, z1: 2.5 };
export const PIT = { x0: SLAB.x0 - 0.3, x1: SLAB.x1 + 0.3, z0: SLAB.z0 - 0.3, z1: SLAB.z1 + 0.3 };
const COLUMNS: [number, number][] = XS.flatMap((x) => ZS.map((z) => [x, z] as [number, number]));

export const GARDEN_TREES: { at: Vec3; h: number; kind: "round" | "column"; seed: number }[] = [
  { at: [-6.6, 0, 1.2], h: 5.8, kind: "round", seed: 3 },
  { at: [6.9, 0, -1.6], h: 6.4, kind: "column", seed: 5 },
  { at: [6.4, 0, -4.6], h: 4.6, kind: "round", seed: 9 },
];
const SHRUBS: { at: Vec3; r: number; seed: number }[] = [
  { at: [-4.7, 0, 3.4], r: 0.5, seed: 21 },
  { at: [-2.0, 0, 3.7], r: 0.42, seed: 22 },
  { at: [2.1, 0, 3.9], r: 0.44, seed: 23 },
  { at: [4.4, 0, 3.0], r: 0.48, seed: 24 },
];

export const SITE: SiteSpec = {
  site: { x0: -10, x1: 10, z0: -8, z1: 11 },
  pit: PIT,
  depth: -LV.pit,
  slab: SLAB,
  beds: GARDEN_TREES.map((t) => ({ x0: t.at[0] - 1.1, x1: t.at[0] + 1.1, z0: t.at[2] - 1.0, z1: t.at[2] + 1.0 })),
  gravelBand: 0.35,
};

/* ───────────────────────── helpers ───────────────────────── */

const lowered = (height: number, rig: "single" | "sling" | "four" = "sling"): Method => ({ kind: "lower", height, rig });

/** A rigid element given by world min/max corners; its seat is the centre of its base. */
const elem = (
  id: string, phase: string, min: Vec3, max: Vec3,
  extra: Partial<Component> & { method: Method; material: string },
  make: (a: Vec3, b: Vec3) => ReturnType<typeof box> = cast,
): Component => {
  const at: Vec3 = [(min[0] + max[0]) / 2, min[1], (min[2] + max[2]) / 2];
  const lmin: Vec3 = [min[0] - at[0], 0, min[2] - at[2]];
  const lmax: Vec3 = [max[0] - at[0], max[1] - at[1], max[2] - at[2]];
  return { id, phase, at, part: { kind: "solid", build: () => [sub(make(lmin, lmax))], bounds: { min: lmin, max: lmax } }, ...extra };
};

/* ───────────────────────── 1 · set-out ───────────────────────── */

const setOut = (): Component[] => {
  const off = 1.2;
  const lines: { id: string; a: [number, number]; b: [number, number] }[] = [
    { id: "front", a: [SLAB.x0 - off, SLAB.z1], b: [SLAB.x1 + off, SLAB.z1] },
    { id: "back", a: [SLAB.x1 + off, SLAB.z0], b: [SLAB.x0 - off, SLAB.z0] },
    { id: "west", a: [SLAB.x0, SLAB.z0 - off], b: [SLAB.x0, SLAB.z1 + off] },
    { id: "east", a: [SLAB.x1, SLAB.z1 + off], b: [SLAB.x1, SLAB.z0 - off] },
  ];
  const out: Component[] = [];
  lines.forEach((l, li) =>
    [l.a, l.b].forEach((p, pi) =>
      out.push({
        id: `stake-${l.id}-${pi}`, phase: "setout", exit: "setout-out", key: li * 2 + pi,
        at: [p[0], 0, p[1]], material: "stake", method: { kind: "drive", depth: 0.35 },
        part: {
          kind: "solid",
          build: () => [sub(box([-0.03, -0.35, -0.03], [0.03, 0.52, 0.03])), sub(box([-0.034, 0.5, -0.034], [0.034, 0.58, 0.034]), "marker")],
          bounds: { min: [-0.034, -0.35, -0.034], max: [0.034, 0.58, 0.034] },
        },
      }),
    ),
  );
  lines.forEach((l, li) => {
    const dx = l.b[0] - l.a[0], dz = l.b[1] - l.a[1], L = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
    out.push({
      id: `string-${l.id}`, phase: "strings", exit: "strings-out", key: li,
      at: [l.a[0], 0.44, l.a[1]], rotY: Math.atan2(-dz, dx), material: "string", method: { kind: "draw" }, shadow: false,
      rests: [`stake-${l.id}-0`, `stake-${l.id}-1`],
      part: { kind: "solid", build: () => [sub(box([0, -0.008, -0.008], [L, 0.008, 0.008]))], bounds: { min: [0, -0.008, -0.008], max: [L, 0.008, 0.008] } },
    });
  });
  return out;
};

/* ───────────────────────── 2 · foundation ───────────────────────── */

const PAD = 0.4;
const foundation = (): Component[] => {
  const out: Component[] = [];
  COLUMNS.forEach(([x, z], i) =>
    out.push(elem(`pad-${x}-${z}`, "footings", [x - PAD, LV.pit + 0.01, z - PAD], [x + PAD, LV.footingTop, z + PAD], { method: { kind: "fill", cure: true }, material: "concrete", key: i }, box)),
  );
  const pads = out.map((c) => c.id);
  const fy0 = LV.slabBottom, fy1 = LV.floor + 0.06, t = 0.025;
  const forms: [string, Vec3, Vec3][] = [
    ["form-front", [SLAB.x0 - t, fy0, SLAB.z1], [SLAB.x1 + t, fy1, SLAB.z1 + t]],
    ["form-back", [SLAB.x0 - t, fy0, SLAB.z0 - t], [SLAB.x1 + t, fy1, SLAB.z0]],
    ["form-west", [SLAB.x0 - t, fy0, SLAB.z0], [SLAB.x0, fy1, SLAB.z1]],
    ["form-east", [SLAB.x1, fy0, SLAB.z0], [SLAB.x1 + t, fy1, SLAB.z1]],
  ];
  forms.forEach(([id, a, b], i) =>
    out.push(elem(id, "formwork", a, b, { method: { kind: "slide", from: [0, 1.1, 0] }, material: "plywood", exit: "strike", after: pads, key: i }, box)),
  );
  const s0: Vec3 = [SLAB.x0, 0, SLAB.z0], s1: Vec3 = [SLAB.x1, LV.floor - LV.slabBottom, SLAB.z1];
  out.push({
    id: "slab", phase: "slab", at: [0, LV.slabBottom, 0], material: "concrete",
    method: { kind: "spread", axis: "x", dir: 1, ramp: 1.0, cure: true },
    rests: pads, after: forms.map((f) => f[0]),
    part: { kind: "solid", build: () => [sub(box(s0, s1, [72, 1, 1]))], bounds: { min: s0, max: s1 } },
  });
  return out;
};

/* ───────────────────────── 3 · steel frame and roof ───────────────────────── */

const colId = (x: number, z: number) => `col-${x}-${z}`;
const xBeam = (z: number) => `beam-x${z}`;
const zBeam = (x: number) => `beam-z${x}`;

const frame = (): Component[] => {
  const out: Component[] = [];
  COLUMNS.forEach(([x, z]) =>
    out.push(elem(colId(x, z), "columns", [x - HC, LV.floor, z - HC], [x + HC, LV.colTop, z + HC], {
      method: lowered(7, "single"), material: "steel", rests: ["slab"], key: XS.indexOf(x),
    }, box)),
  );
  // two main beams along x, sitting on the column heads
  ZS.forEach((z, i) =>
    out.push(elem(xBeam(z), "beams", [XS[0] - 0.2, LV.colTop, z - 0.09], [XS[2] + 0.2, LV.beamTop, z + 0.09], {
      method: lowered(8), material: "steel", rests: XS.map((x) => colId(x, z)), key: i,
    }, box)),
  );
  // cross beams along z, between the main beams
  XS.forEach((x, i) =>
    out.push(elem(zBeam(x), "crossbeams", [x - 0.07, LV.colTop, ZS[0] + 0.09], [x + 0.07, LV.beamTop, ZS[1] - 0.09], {
      method: lowered(7), material: "steel", rests: ZS.map(xBeam), key: i,
    }, box)),
  );
  // timber roof boards laid one by one across the beams
  const boards: Piece[] = [];
  for (let x = -3.6, k = 0; x <= 3.6 + 1e-6; x += 0.2, k++)
    boards.push({ c: [x, (LV.beamTop + LV.boardsTop) / 2, 0], s: [0.19, LV.boardsTop - LV.beamTop, 5.4], tone: 0.9 + ((k * 37) % 11) / 70 });
  out.push({
    id: "roof-boards", phase: "roof", at: [0, 0, 0], material: "woodPiece",
    method: { kind: "lay", from: [0, 0.5, 0], each: 0.08 }, part: { kind: "pieces", pieces: boards },
    rests: [...ZS.map(xBeam), ...XS.map(zBeam)],
  });
  // thin roof cap lifted onto the boards
  out.push(elem("roof-cap", "cap", [-3.75, LV.boardsTop, -2.82], [3.75, LV.capTop, 2.82], {
    method: lowered(9, "four"), material: "render", rests: ["roof-boards"],
  }, (a, b) => cast(a, b, 0.02)));
  return out;
};

/* ───────────────────────── 4 · infill and fit-out ───────────────────────── */

const infill = (): Component[] => {
  const out: Component[] = [];
  const h = LV.colTop - LV.floor;
  // back wall: two glazed bays between the columns (outside is −z, so the unit is turned 180°)
  [[XS[0] + HC, XS[1] - HC], [XS[1] + HC, XS[2] - HC]].forEach(([x0, x1], i) => {
    const w = x1 - x0;
    out.push({
      id: `glazing-${i}`, phase: "glazing", key: i, at: [x1, LV.floor, ZS[0]], rotY: Math.PI, material: "frame",
      method: { kind: "slide", from: [0, 0, 1.6] },
      part: { kind: "solid", build: () => glazing(w, h, { maxPane: 1.0 }), bounds: { min: [0, 0, -0.05], max: [w, h, 0.05] } },
      rests: ["slab"], after: [xBeam(ZS[0])],
    });
  });
  // west side: a slatted timber screen, two rails then vertical slats
  const slats: Piece[] = [];
  const z0 = ZS[0] + HC, z1 = ZS[1] - HC, x = XS[0];
  for (const y of [LV.floor + 0.45, LV.colTop - 0.35]) slats.push({ c: [x + 0.045, y, (z0 + z1) / 2], s: [0.05, 0.05, z1 - z0], tone: 0.8 });
  for (let z = z0 + 0.04, k = 0; z <= z1 - 0.039; z += 0.11, k++) slats.push({ c: [x, (LV.floor + LV.colTop) / 2, z], s: [0.04, h, 0.05], tone: 0.92 + ((k * 29) % 9) / 70 });
  out.push({
    id: "screen", phase: "screen", at: [0, 0, 0], material: "woodPiece",
    method: { kind: "lay", from: [-0.8, 0, 0], each: 0.1 }, part: { kind: "pieces", pieces: slats },
    rests: ["slab"], after: [zBeam(XS[0])],
  });
  // a timber bench in front of the glazing
  const legs = [-1.8, 0, 1.8].map((lx) => box([lx - 0.05, 0, -0.18], [lx + 0.05, 0.4, 0.18]));
  out.push({
    id: "bench", phase: "bench", at: [0, LV.floor, -1.5], material: "wood",
    method: { kind: "slide", from: [0, 0.4, 1.2] },
    part: { kind: "solid", build: () => [sub(merge([...legs, box([-2, 0.4, -0.22], [2, 0.46, 0.22])]))], bounds: { min: [-2, 0, -0.22], max: [2, 0.46, 0.22] } },
    rests: ["slab"], after: ["glazing-0", "glazing-1"],
  });
  // stepping-stone path to the front
  const pavers: Piece[] = Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, k) => ({ c: [0, 0.03, SLAB.z1 + 0.6 + k * 0.85], s: [1.4, 0.06, 0.6], tone: 0.95 + ((k * 7) % 5) / 50 }));
  out.push({ id: "path", phase: "paving", at: [0, 0, 0], material: "paver", method: { kind: "lay", from: [0, 0.35, 0], each: 0.22 }, part: { kind: "pieces", pieces: pavers } });
  return out;
};

/* ───────────────────────── 5 · planting ───────────────────────── */

const tree = (t: (typeof GARDEN_TREES)[number]): Component["part"] => ({
  kind: "solid",
  build: () => (t.kind === "round" ? roundTree(t.h, t.seed, LEAF.garden) : columnTree(t.h, t.seed, LEAF.garden)),
  bounds: { min: [-t.h * 0.3, 0, -t.h * 0.3], max: [t.h * 0.3, t.h, t.h * 0.3] },
});

const planting = (): Component[] => [
  ...GARDEN_TREES.map((t, i): Component => ({ id: `tree-${i}`, phase: "trees", key: i, at: t.at, material: "foliage", method: { kind: "grow" }, part: tree(t) })),
  ...SHRUBS.map((s, i): Component => ({
    id: `shrub-${i}`, phase: "shrubs", key: i, at: s.at, material: "foliage", method: { kind: "grow" },
    part: { kind: "solid", build: () => shrub(s.r, s.seed, LEAF.shrub), bounds: { min: [-s.r, 0, -s.r], max: [s.r, s.r * 1.4, s.r] } },
  })),
];

export const pavilionComponents = (): Component[] => [...setOut(), ...foundation(), ...frame(), ...infill(), ...planting()];

==== 3434 src/kits/buildforge/example/sequence.ts
// Assembly sequence of the pavilion example. Phase windows are written in seconds of film time and
// converted to the construction clock (CLOCK units per second), so motion constants keep their
// real-time feel at any render frame rate. Which component belongs to which phase lives in
// pavilion.ts; the per-component timeline is derived by schedule(); scripts/buildforge-check.ts
// proves the sequence is physically ordered and clash-free.

import type { PhaseWindow } from "../assembly/schedule.ts";
import type { TerrainState } from "../environment/Terrain.ts";
import type { Stage } from "../labels/StageLabel.tsx";
import { ease, remap } from "../motion/easing.ts";
import { keys } from "../motion/track.ts";

/** Construction-clock units per second (the engine's motion constants assume 30). */
export const CLOCK = 30;
export const EXAMPLE_SECONDS = 10;
/** Seconds → clock units, rounded so windows written in seconds never lose a hair to float error. */
const sec = (v: number) => Math.round(v * CLOCK * 1000) / 1000;
const w = (phase: string, a: number, b: number, dur: number): PhaseWindow => ({ phase, start: sec(a), end: sec(b), dur: sec(dur) });

export const WINDOWS: PhaseWindow[] = [
  // 1 · the land
  w("setout", 0.6, 1.5, 0.3),
  w("strings", 1.3, 1.9, 0.3),
  // 2 · foundation
  w("footings", 2.6, 3.3, 0.35),
  w("strings-out", 3.2, 3.45, 0.15),
  w("setout-out", 3.45, 3.75, 0.2),
  w("formwork", 3.3, 3.75, 0.3),
  w("slab", 3.75, 4.6, 0.8),
  w("strike", 4.7, 5.0, 0.25),
  // 3 · frame
  w("columns", 4.9, 5.7, 0.4),
  w("beams", 5.7, 6.2, 0.4),
  w("crossbeams", 6.2, 6.6, 0.3),
  // 4 · roof and walls
  w("roof", 6.6, 7.4, 0.8),
  w("cap", 7.4, 7.9, 0.5),
  w("glazing", 6.7, 7.4, 0.45),
  w("screen", 7.4, 8.2, 0.8),
  // 5 · finished
  w("bench", 8.0, 8.4, 0.35),
  w("paving", 8.1, 8.9, 0.8),
  w("trees", 8.2, 9.2, 0.8),
  w("shrubs", 8.5, 9.3, 0.5),
];

/** Ground operations (not components). */
export const terrainAt = (c: number): TerrainState => ({
  contour: 1 - remap(c, sec(0.2), sec(0.9)),
  grade: ease.inOut(remap(c, sec(0.5), sec(1.3))),
  dig: ease.inOut(remap(c, sec(1.9), sec(3.0))),
  backfill: ease.inOut(remap(c, sec(4.7), sec(5.2))),
  lawn: ease.out(remap(c, sec(8.0), sec(9.3))),
});

/** Everything must be in place before this clock value (a short hold at the end). */
export const END = sec(9.6);

/** Stage labels, in seconds (the film converts them to frames). */
export const STAGES_S: Stage[] = [
  { from: 0, to: 1.9, n: "01", label: "LAHAN" },
  { from: 1.9, to: 4.8, n: "02", label: "FONDASI" },
  { from: 4.8, to: 6.6, n: "03", label: "RANGKA" },
  { from: 6.6, to: 8.0, n: "04", label: "ATAP & DINDING" },
  { from: 8.0, to: EXAMPLE_SECONDS, n: "05", label: "SELESAI" },
];

/**
 * Camera: one continuous move on the construction clock.
 * [clock, targetX, targetY, targetZ, azimuth°, elevation°, distance, fov°]; azimuth 0 looks at the
 * front (+z), positive swings the camera east (+x).
 */
export const RIG = keys(
  [sec(0), 0, 0.4, 1, -38, 22, 36, 36],
  [sec(1.6), 0, 0.0, 0.5, -30, 34, 29, 36],
  [sec(3.4), 0, -0.2, 0, -18, 42, 27, 36],
