==== 1590 src/kits/buildforge/geometry/noise.ts
// Seeded randomness and smooth value noise. Everything procedural derives from fixed seeds,
// so a frame renders identically on every machine and every render pass.

export const rng = (seed: number) => {
  let a = seed >>> 0;
  return () => {
    a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) >>> 0;
    let t = a;
    t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
    t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
};

const hash2 = (x: number, y: number) => {
  let h = (x * 374761393 + y * 668265263) | 0;
  h = Math.imul(h ^ (h >>> 13), 1274126177);
  return ((h ^ (h >>> 16)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
};

const fade = (t: number) => t * t * (3 - 2 * t);

/** 2D value noise in [0, 1]. */
export const noise2 = (x: number, y: number) => {
  const xi = Math.floor(x), yi = Math.floor(y);
  const xf = fade(x - xi), yf = fade(y - yi);
  const a = hash2(xi, yi), b = hash2(xi + 1, yi), c = hash2(xi, yi + 1), d = hash2(xi + 1, yi + 1);
  return a + (b - a) * xf + (c - a) * yf + (a - b - c + d) * xf * yf;
};

/** Fractal noise centred on 0, roughly in [-0.5, 0.5]. */
export const fbm2 = (x: number, y: number, octaves = 4) => {
  let s = 0, amp = 0.5, f = 1, norm = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < octaves; i++) {
    s += amp * (noise2(x * f + i * 17.3, y * f - i * 9.1) - 0.5);
    norm += amp;
    amp *= 0.5;
    f *= 2.03;
  }
  return s / norm;
};

/** Cheap 3D noise for organic displacement (foliage), in [-0.5, 0.5]. */
export const noise3 = (x: number, y: number, z: number) => (noise2(x + z * 1.7, y - z * 0.6) + noise2(y * 1.3 - z, x * 0.8 + z * 1.1)) * 0.5 - 0.5;

==== 2411 src/kits/buildforge/geometry/openings.ts
// Installable units that fill openings: glazing, doors, balustrades. Local origin is the
// bottom-left corner of the opening; the unit's mid-plane sits on z = 0, outside is +z.

import { box, merge, sub } from "./shapes.ts";
import type { SubMesh } from "../types.ts";

export type GlazingOpts = { frame?: number; depth?: number; maxPane?: number; transom?: number };

/** Aluminium frame with mullions every ≤ maxPane metres, an optional transom, and glass. */
export const glazing = (w: number, h: number, o: GlazingOpts = {}): SubMesh[] => {
  const f = o.frame ?? 0.06, d = (o.depth ?? 0.07) / 2, maxPane = o.maxPane ?? 1.5;
  const gap = 0.002;
  const W = w - gap * 2, H = h - gap * 2;
  const x0 = gap, y0 = gap;
  const n = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(W / maxPane));
  const parts = [
    box([x0, y0, -d], [x0 + f, y0 + H, d]),
    box([x0 + W - f, y0, -d], [x0 + W, y0 + H, d]),
    box([x0 + f, y0, -d], [x0 + W - f, y0 + f, d]),
    box([x0 + f, y0 + H - f, -d], [x0 + W - f, y0 + H, d]),
  ];
  for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) {
    const x = x0 + (W * i) / n;
    parts.push(box([x - f * 0.4, y0 + f, -d * 0.9], [x + f * 0.4, y0 + H - f, d * 0.9]));
  }
  if (o.transom) parts.push(box([x0 + f, y0 + o.transom - f * 0.4, -d * 0.9], [x0 + W - f, y0 + o.transom + f * 0.4, d * 0.9]));
  const glass = box([x0 + f * 0.5, y0 + f * 0.5, -0.006], [x0 + W - f * 0.5, y0 + H - f * 0.5, 0.006]);
  return [sub(merge(parts), "frame"), sub(glass, "glass")];
};

/** Full-height pivot door: slim frame, solid timber leaf, long steel pull. */
export const pivotDoor = (w: number, h: number): SubMesh[] => {
  const f = 0.05, d = 0.04, gap = 0.002;
  const frame = merge([
    box([gap, gap, -d], [gap + f, h - gap, d]),
    box([w - gap - f, gap, -d], [w - gap, h - gap, d]),
    box([gap + f, h - gap - f, -d], [w - gap - f, h - gap, d]),
  ]);
  const leaf = box([gap + f + 0.004, 0.01, -0.03], [w - gap - f - 0.004, h - gap - f - 0.004, 0.03]);
  const pull = merge([
    box([w - 0.32, 0.75, 0.03], [w - 0.29, 1.95, 0.065]),
    box([w - 0.32, 0.8, 0.03], [w - 0.29, 0.84, 0.065]),
  ]);
  return [sub(frame, "frame"), sub(leaf, "wood"), sub(pull, "steel")];
};

/** Frameless glass balustrade panel in a steel base shoe. */
export const balustrade = (w: number, h: number): SubMesh[] => [
  sub(box([0, 0, -0.05], [w, 0.1, 0.05]), "steel"),
  sub(box([0.004, 0.06, -0.008], [w - 0.004, h, 0.008]), "glass"),
];

==== 7092 src/kits/buildforge/geometry/shapes.ts
// Building-geometry primitives in metres. UVs are metric (1 unit = 1 m) so textures keep
// one density on every element, whatever its size.

import { BoxGeometry, BufferGeometry, Float32BufferAttribute } from "three";
import { RoundedBoxGeometry } from "three/examples/jsm/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js";
import { mergeGeometries } from "three/examples/jsm/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js";
import type { Piece, SubMesh, Vec3 } from "../types.ts";

/** Planar UVs from the dominant normal axis, in metres. */
export const metricUV = (g: BufferGeometry) => {
  const p = g.attributes.position, n = g.attributes.normal;
  const uv = new Float32Array(p.count * 2);
  for (let i = 0; i < p.count; i++) {
    const ax = Math.abs(n.getX(i)), ay = Math.abs(n.getY(i)), az = Math.abs(n.getZ(i));
    const [u, v] = ax >= ay && ax >= az ? [p.getZ(i), p.getY(i)] : ay >= az ? [p.getX(i), p.getZ(i)] : [p.getX(i), p.getY(i)];
    uv[i * 2] = u;
    uv[i * 2 + 1] = v;
  }
  g.setAttribute("uv", new Float32BufferAttribute(uv, 2));
  return g;
};

export const merge = (gs: BufferGeometry[]) => {
  const m = mergeGeometries(gs.map((g) => (g.index ? g.toNonIndexed() : g)), false);
  if (!m) throw new Error("merge failed");
  return m;
};

const size = (min: Vec3, max: Vec3): Vec3 => [max[0] - min[0], max[1] - min[1], max[2] - min[2]];
const centre = (min: Vec3, max: Vec3): Vec3 => [(min[0] + max[0]) / 2, (min[1] + max[1]) / 2, (min[2] + max[2]) / 2];

/** Axis-aligned box between two corners. `segs` subdivides (a pour front needs vertices to bend). */
export const box = (min: Vec3, max: Vec3, segs: [number, number, number] = [1, 1, 1]) => {
  const s = size(min, max), c = centre(min, max);
  const g = new BoxGeometry(s[0], s[1], s[2], ...segs);
  g.translate(...c);
  return metricUV(g);
};

/** Precast element: a box with a small arris radius so the edges catch light like real cast concrete. */
export const cast = (min: Vec3, max: Vec3, radius = 0.012) => {
  const s = size(min, max), c = centre(min, max);
  const g = new RoundedBoxGeometry(s[0], s[1], s[2], 2, Math.min(radius, Math.min(...s) * 0.3));
  g.translate(...c);
  return metricUV(g);
};

/** Opening in wall coordinates: [x0, x1, y0, y1], x along the wall, y up from the floor. */
export type Rect = [number, number, number, number];

/** Solid parts of an L × H rectangle minus openings, as non-overlapping vertical strips. */
export const solidRects = (L: number, H: number, holes: Rect[]): Rect[] => {
  const cl = (v: number) => Math.min(L, Math.max(0, v));
  const xs = [...new Set([0, L, ...holes.flatMap((h) => [cl(h[0]), cl(h[1])])])].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const out: Rect[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < xs.length - 1; i++) {
    const a = xs[i], b = xs[i + 1];
    if (b - a < 1e-4) continue;
    const mid = (a + b) / 2;
    const cuts = holes
      .filter((h) => h[0] < mid && h[1] > mid)
      .map((h) => [Math.max(0, h[2]), Math.min(H, h[3])])
      .sort((p, q) => p[0] - q[0]);
    let y = 0;
    for (const [y0, y1] of cuts) {
      if (y0 - y > 1e-4) out.push([a, b, y, y0]);
      y = Math.max(y, y1);
    }
    if (H - y > 1e-4) out.push([a, b, y, H]);
  }
  return out;
};

/** Flat panel (render coat, cladding board) with openings, between local z0 and z1. */
export const panelBoxes = (L: number, H: number, z0: number, z1: number, holes: Rect[]): [Vec3, Vec3][] =>
  solidRects(L, H, holes).map((r) => [[r[0], r[2], z0], [r[1], r[3], z1]]);
export const panel = (L: number, H: number, z0: number, z1: number, holes: Rect[]) => merge(panelBoxes(L, H, z0, z1, holes).map(([a, b]) => box(a, b)));

type Span = [number, number];
const subtract = (span: Span, cuts: Span[]): Span[] => {
  let out: Span[] = [span];
  for (const [c0, c1] of cuts) {
    out = out.flatMap(([a, b]) => {
      if (c1 <= a || c0 >= b) return [[a, b] as Span];
      const r: Span[] = [];
      if (c0 > a) r.push([a, c0]);
      if (c1 < b) r.push([c1, b]);
      return r;
    });
  }
  return out.filter(([a, b]) => b - a > 1e-3);
};

/**
 * Running-bond blockwork filling an L × H bay around openings (opening edges sit on course
 * lines), a precast lintel over every opening that stops below the top, and a recessed mortar
 * bed per course. Pieces come out in laying order: course by course, along the wall.
 */
export const masonry = (L: number, H: number, z0: number, z1: number, holes: Rect[], o = { block: 0.4, course: 0.2, joint: 0.01 }) => {
  const pieces: Piece[] = [];
  const t = z1 - z0, zc = (z0 + z1) / 2;
  const lintels = holes.filter((h) => h[3] < H - 1e-3).map((h) => ({ x0: Math.max(0, h[0] - 0.2), x1: Math.min(L, h[1] + 0.2), y0: h[3], y1: Math.min(H, h[3] + o.course), done: false }));
  let tone = 0.37;
  for (let k = 0, y = 0; y < H - 1e-4; k++, y += o.course) {
    const y1 = Math.min(H, y + o.course), h = y1 - y;
    const blocked: Span[] = holes.filter((q) => q[2] < y1 - 1e-4 && q[3] > y + 1e-4).map((q) => [q[0], q[1]]);
    const course: Piece[] = [];
    for (const l of lintels) {
      if (l.y0 < y1 - 1e-4 && l.y1 > y + 1e-4) {
        blocked.push([l.x0, l.x1]);
        if (!l.done) {
          course.push({ c: [(l.x0 + l.x1) / 2, (l.y0 + l.y1 - o.joint) / 2, zc], s: [l.x1 - l.x0 - o.joint, l.y1 - l.y0 - o.joint, t], tone: 1.06 });
          l.done = true;
        }
      }
    }
    const offset = (k % 2) * (o.block / 2);
    const spans = subtract([0, L], blocked);
    for (const [a, b] of spans) {
      const cuts = [a];
      for (let g = Math.ceil((a + offset) / o.block) * o.block - offset; g < b - 0.05; g += o.block) if (g > a + 0.05) cuts.push(g);
      cuts.push(b);
      for (let i = 0; i < cuts.length - 1; i++) {
        tone = (tone * 9301 + 49297) % 233280 / 233280;
        course.push({ c: [(cuts[i] + cuts[i + 1]) / 2, y + (h - o.joint) / 2, zc], s: [cuts[i + 1] - cuts[i] - o.joint, h - o.joint, t], tone: 0.93 + tone * 0.1 });
      }
    }
    course.sort((p, q) => p.c[0] - q.c[0]);
    pieces.push(...course);
    // mortar bed: recessed, appears once the course is complete so open joints never show daylight
    for (const [a, b] of spans) pieces.push({ c: [(a + b) / 2, y + h / 2, zc], s: [b - a, h, t - 0.024], tone: 0.82, instant: true });
  }
  return pieces;
};

/** Local bounds of a piece list. */
export const pieceBounds = (pieces: Piece[]) => {
  const min: Vec3 = [Infinity, Infinity, Infinity], max: Vec3 = [-Infinity, -Infinity, -Infinity];
  for (const p of pieces)
    for (let a = 0; a < 3; a++) {
      min[a] = Math.min(min[a], p.c[a] - p.s[a] / 2);
      max[a] = Math.max(max[a], p.c[a] + p.s[a] / 2);
    }
  return { min, max };
};

/** Bounds of a set of boxes given as [min, max] corners. */
export const boundsOf = (...boxes: [Vec3, Vec3][]) => {
  const min: Vec3 = [Infinity, Infinity, Infinity], max: Vec3 = [-Infinity, -Infinity, -Infinity];
  for (const [a, b] of boxes)
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      min[i] = Math.min(min[i], a[i]);
      max[i] = Math.max(max[i], b[i]);
    }
  return { min, max };
};

export const sub = (geom: BufferGeometry, material?: string): SubMesh => ({ geom, material });

==== 2339 src/kits/buildforge/labels/StageLabel.tsx
// Stage label: a small numbered caption and a five-stop progress rail. Deliberately quiet;
// the construction carries the story. Laid out at 1080 × 1920 and scaled to the render size.

import React from "react";
import { ease, remap } from "../motion/easing.ts";

export type Stage = { from: number; to: number; n: string; label: string };

export const StageLabel: React.FC<{
  stages: Stage[]; frame: number; fps?: number; show?: number; width: number; font: string; ink: string; soft: string; accent: string;
}> = ({ stages, frame, fps = 30, show = 1, width, font, ink, soft, accent }) => {
  const k = width / 1080;
  const r = fps / 30; // timings are authored at 30 fps
  const T = 14 * r;
  const intro = ease.type(remap(frame, 6 * r, 30 * r)) * show;
  const total = stages[stages.length - 1].to;
  if (intro <= 0.001) return null;
  return (
    <div style={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0, width: 1080, height: 1920, transform: `scale(${k})`, transformOrigin: "0 0", fontFamily: font, opacity: intro }}>
      {stages.map((s, i) => {
        const inK = i === 0 ? 1 : ease.type(remap(frame, s.from, s.from + T));
        const outK = i === stages.length - 1 ? 0 : ease.type(remap(frame, s.to - 4 * r, s.to + T - 6 * r));
        const v = inK * (1 - outK);
        if (v <= 0.001) return null;
        return (
          <div key={s.n} style={{ position: "absolute", left: 92, top: 132, opacity: v, transform: `translateY(${(1 - inK) * 22 - outK * 18}px)` }}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 26, fontWeight: 600, letterSpacing: "0.32em", color: accent }}>{s.n}</div>
            <div style={{ marginTop: 6, fontSize: 40, fontWeight: 500, letterSpacing: "0.2em", color: ink }}>{s.label}</div>
          </div>
        );
      })}
      <div style={{ position: "absolute", left: 92, top: 252, width: 300, height: 3, background: soft, opacity: 0.35 }} />
      <div style={{ position: "absolute", left: 92, top: 252, width: 300 * Math.min(1, frame / total), height: 3, background: accent }} />
      {stages.map((s, i) => (
        <div key={`t${s.n}`} style={{ position: "absolute", left: 92 + (300 * s.from) / total - 3, top: 249, width: 9, height: 9, borderRadius: 9, background: frame >= s.from ? accent : soft, opacity: frame >= s.from ? 1 : 0.4, display: i === 0 ? "none" : "block" }} />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
};

==== 7142 src/kits/buildforge/materials/library.ts
// Material system. Every construction material is a MeshStandardMaterial extended with three
// state channels, all driven from the timeline:
//   wet    — fresh concrete reads darker and glossier, then cures;
//   coat   — a finish coat exists only below a rising front (fragments above are discarded);
//   finish — a shared world-space sweep turns raw surfaces into their finish material behind
//            a travelling front (a change of surface, never a crossfade).

import { Color, MeshPhysicalMaterial, MeshStandardMaterial, Vector3, type Material } from "three";
import { texture } from "./textures.ts";

export type Look = {
  color: string;
  roughness: number;
  metalness?: number;
  tex?: "concrete" | "wood" | "gravel";
  /** Metres per texture tile (metric UVs); 1 for instanced pieces (unit UVs). */
  tile?: number;
  vertexColors?: boolean;
  env?: number;
  /** Foliage: leaf-clump shading (noise-perturbed normals and tone) instead of smooth blobs. */
  leaf?: boolean;
  /** Light fitting: emissive colour, switched on through `lamps`. */
  emissive?: string;
};

export type Sweep = { front: { value: number }; dir: { value: Vector3 }; soft: { value: number } };
export const makeSweep = (dir: [number, number, number], soft: number): Sweep => ({
  front: { value: -1e5 },
  dir: { value: new Vector3(...dir).normalize() },
  soft: { value: soft },
});

export type BuildUniforms = {
  uWet: { value: number };
  uCoat: { value: number };
  uFinColor: { value: Color };
  uFinRough: { value: number };
  uFinOn: { value: number };
  uFront: { value: number };
  uDir: { value: Vector3 };
  uSoft: { value: number };
};

const VERT_HEAD = /* glsl */ `
varying vec3 vBfWorld;
#ifdef BF_IALPHA
attribute float aAlpha;
varying float vBfAlpha;
#endif
#ifdef BF_FADE
varying float vBfFade;
#endif
`;
const VERT_BODY = /* glsl */ `
#include <project_vertex>
{
  vec4 bfp = vec4(transformed, 1.0);
  #ifdef USE_INSTANCING
  bfp = instanceMatrix * bfp;
  #endif
  vBfWorld = (modelMatrix * bfp).xyz;
}
#ifdef BF_IALPHA
vBfAlpha = aAlpha;
#endif
#ifdef BF_FADE
vBfFade = position.y + 0.5;
#endif
`;
const FRAG_HEAD = /* glsl */ `
uniform float uWet; uniform float uCoat; uniform vec3 uFinColor; uniform float uFinRough; uniform float uFinOn;
uniform float uFront; uniform vec3 uDir; uniform float uSoft;
varying vec3 vBfWorld;
#ifdef BF_IALPHA
varying float vBfAlpha;
#endif
#ifdef BF_FADE
varying float vBfFade;
#endif
#ifdef BF_LEAF
float bfh(vec3 p){ return fract(sin(dot(p, vec3(127.1, 311.7, 74.7))) * 43758.5453); }
float bfn(vec3 p){
  vec3 i = floor(p), f = fract(p); f = f * f * (3.0 - 2.0 * f);
  return mix(mix(mix(bfh(i), bfh(i + vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0)), f.x), mix(bfh(i + vec3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0)), bfh(i + vec3(1.0, 1.0, 0.0)), f.x), f.y),
             mix(mix(bfh(i + vec3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0)), bfh(i + vec3(1.0, 0.0, 1.0)), f.x), mix(bfh(i + vec3(0.0, 1.0, 1.0)), bfh(i + vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0)), f.x), f.y), f.z);
}
#endif
`;
const FRAG_CLIP = /* glsl */ `
#include <clipping_planes_fragment>
if (vBfWorld.y > uCoat) discard;
`;
const FRAG_COLOR = /* glsl */ `
#include <map_fragment>
float bfFin = uFinOn * (1.0 - smoothstep(uFront - uSoft, uFront + uSoft, dot(vBfWorld, uDir)));
diffuseColor.rgb = mix(diffuseColor.rgb, uFinColor, bfFin);
diffuseColor.rgb *= mix(1.0, 0.62, uWet);
// the freshest band of a coat, just under its front, is still damp
diffuseColor.rgb *= 1.0 - 0.12 * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.45, uCoat - vBfWorld.y));
#ifdef BF_IALPHA
diffuseColor.a *= vBfAlpha;
#endif
#ifdef BF_FADE
// crane cable dissolves upward: the crane itself stays out of the story
diffuseColor.a *= 1.0 - smoothstep(0.004, 0.045, vBfFade);
#endif
#ifdef BF_LEAF
diffuseColor.rgb *= 0.78 + 0.42 * bfn(vBfWorld * 4.5) * (0.6 + 0.4 * bfn(vBfWorld * 13.0));
#endif
`;
const FRAG_NORMAL = /* glsl */ `
#include <normal_fragment_maps>
#ifdef BF_LEAF
{
  vec3 q = vBfWorld * 6.5;
  vec3 g = vec3(bfn(q), bfn(q + 17.3), bfn(q + 41.9)) - 0.5;
  normal = normalize(normal + (viewMatrix * vec4(g, 0.0)).xyz * 1.3);
}
#endif
`;
const FRAG_ROUGH = /* glsl */ `
#include <roughnessmap_fragment>
roughnessFactor = mix(roughnessFactor, uFinRough, bfFin);
roughnessFactor = mix(roughnessFactor, 0.2, uWet);
`;

export type MakeOpts = { finish?: { material: string; sweep: string }; pieces?: boolean; fade?: boolean };

export const createLibrary = (looks: Record<string, Look>, sweeps: Record<string, Sweep>) => {
  /** Every light-fitting material made, so the film can switch them on together. */
  const lamps: MeshStandardMaterial[] = [];
  const glass = () =>
    new MeshPhysicalMaterial({
      color: new Color("#a9c3cb"),
      metalness: 0.05,
      roughness: 0.035,
      transparent: true,
      opacity: 0.42,
      envMapIntensity: 2.2,
      ior: 1.5,
      specularIntensity: 1,
      depthWrite: false,
    });

  const make = (id: string, o: MakeOpts = {}): Material => {
    if (id === "glass") return glass();
    const look = looks[id];
    if (!look) throw new Error(`BUILDFORGE: unknown material "${id}"`);
    const m = new MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: new Color(look.color),
      roughness: look.roughness,
      metalness: look.metalness ?? 0,
      map: look.tex ? texture(look.tex, look.tile ?? 1) : null,
      vertexColors: look.vertexColors ?? false,
      envMapIntensity: look.env ?? 1,
    });
    if (look.emissive) {
      m.emissive = new Color(look.emissive);
      m.emissiveIntensity = 0;
      lamps.push(m);
    }
    const fin = o.finish ? looks[o.finish.material] : undefined;
    const sw = o.finish ? sweeps[o.finish.sweep] : undefined;
    if (o.finish && (!fin || !sw)) throw new Error(`BUILDFORGE: bad finish ${JSON.stringify(o.finish)}`);
    const u: BuildUniforms = {
      uWet: { value: 0 },
      uCoat: { value: 1e5 },
      uFinColor: { value: new Color(fin?.color ?? "#ffffff") },
      uFinRough: { value: fin?.roughness ?? 1 },
      uFinOn: { value: fin ? 1 : 0 },
      uFront: sw?.front ?? { value: -1e5 },
      uDir: sw?.dir ?? { value: new Vector3(0, 1, 0) },
      uSoft: sw?.soft ?? { value: 1 },
    };
    m.defines = {};
    if (o.pieces) m.defines.BF_IALPHA = "";
    if (o.fade) m.defines.BF_FADE = "";
    if (look.leaf) m.defines.BF_LEAF = "";
    m.onBeforeCompile = (s) => {
      Object.assign(s.uniforms, u);
      s.vertexShader = s.vertexShader.replace("#include <common>", `#include <common>\n${VERT_HEAD}`).replace("#include <project_vertex>", VERT_BODY);
      s.fragmentShader = s.fragmentShader
        .replace("#include <common>", `#include <common>\n${FRAG_HEAD}`)
        .replace("#include <clipping_planes_fragment>", FRAG_CLIP)
        .replace("#include <map_fragment>", FRAG_COLOR)
        .replace("#include <normal_fragment_maps>", FRAG_NORMAL)
        .replace("#include <roughnessmap_fragment>", FRAG_ROUGH);
    };
    m.customProgramCacheKey = () => `bf-${Object.keys(m.defines ?? {}).join("-")}`;
    m.userData.bf = u;
    return m;
  };
  const setLamps = (on: number) => lamps.forEach((m) => (m.emissiveIntensity = on * 6));
  return { make, looks, sweeps, setLamps };
};

export type Library = ReturnType<typeof createLibrary>;

==== 3909 src/kits/buildforge/materials/textures.ts
// Procedural, seamless surface textures drawn once on canvas from fixed seeds. They are
// near-white so the material colour sets the tone and the map only adds life.

import { CanvasTexture, RepeatWrapping, SRGBColorSpace, type Texture } from "three";
import { rng } from "../geometry/noise.ts";

const canvas = (w: number, h: number) => {
  const cv = document.createElement("canvas");
  cv.width = w;
  cv.height = h;
  return { cv, g: cv.getContext("2d")! };
};

const finish = (cv: HTMLCanvasElement) => {
  const t = new CanvasTexture(cv);
  t.wrapS = t.wrapT = RepeatWrapping;
  t.colorSpace = SRGBColorSpace;
  t.anisotropy = 8;
  return t;
};

/** Dabs drawn with wrap-around so the tile is seamless. */
const dabs = (g: CanvasRenderingContext2D, w: number, h: number, n: number, r: () => number, rad: [number, number], alpha: number) => {
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const x = r() * w, y = r() * h, rr = rad[0] + r() * (rad[1] - rad[0]);
    g.fillStyle = r() < 0.5 ? `rgba(0,0,0,${r() * alpha})` : `rgba(255,255,255,${r() * alpha})`;
    for (const dx of [-w, 0, w])
      for (const dy of [-h, 0, h]) {
        g.beginPath();
        g.arc(x + dx, y + dy, rr, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        g.fill();
      }
  }
};

const grain = (g: CanvasRenderingContext2D, w: number, h: number, r: () => number, amp: number) => {
  const img = g.getImageData(0, 0, w, h);
  for (let i = 0; i < img.data.length; i += 4) {
    const d = (r() - 0.5) * amp;
    img.data[i] += d;
    img.data[i + 1] += d;
    img.data[i + 2] += d;
  }
  g.putImageData(img, 0, 0);
};

export const concreteTexture = () => {
  const { cv, g } = canvas(512, 512);
  const r = rng(11);
  g.fillStyle = "#f2f2f2";
  g.fillRect(0, 0, 512, 512);
  dabs(g, 512, 512, 900, r, [10, 70], 0.035);
  dabs(g, 512, 512, 2600, r, [1, 3], 0.12);
  grain(g, 512, 512, r, 10);
  return finish(cv);
};

export const woodTexture = () => {
  const { cv, g } = canvas(256, 512);
  const r = rng(23);
  const img = g.createImageData(256, 512);
  const phase = Array.from({ length: 6 }, () => r() * 6.28);
  for (let x = 0; x < 256; x++) {
    // grain runs along v (the board's length)
    for (let y = 0; y < 512; y++) {
      const wob = Math.sin((y / 512) * 6.283 * 2 + phase[0]) * 3 + Math.sin((y / 512) * 6.283 * 5 + phase[1]) * 1.2;
      const xx = x + wob;
      const ring = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin((xx / 256) * 6.283 * 9 + Math.sin((xx / 256) * 6.283 * 2 + phase[2]) * 2.2);
      const fine = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin((xx / 256) * 6.283 * 41 + phase[3]);
      const v = 0.8 + ring * 0.13 + fine * 0.05 + (r() - 0.5) * 0.04;
      const i = (y * 256 + x) * 4;
      img.data[i] = 255 * Math.min(1, v * 1.02);
      img.data[i + 1] = 255 * Math.min(1, v * 0.97);
      img.data[i + 2] = 255 * Math.min(1, v * 0.9);
      img.data[i + 3] = 255;
    }
  }
  g.putImageData(img, 0, 0);
  return finish(cv);
};

export const gravelTexture = () => {
  const { cv, g } = canvas(256, 256);
  const r = rng(37);
  g.fillStyle = "#d8d8d8";
  g.fillRect(0, 0, 256, 256);
  for (let i = 0; i < 1400; i++) {
    const x = r() * 256, y = r() * 256, rr = 1.5 + r() * 4.5, v = 150 + r() * 105;
    g.fillStyle = `rgb(${v},${v * 0.98},${v * 0.94})`;
    for (const dx of [-256, 0, 256])
      for (const dy of [-256, 0, 256]) {
        g.beginPath();
        g.ellipse(x + dx, y + dy, rr, rr * (0.6 + r() * 0.4), r() * 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        g.fill();
      }
  }
  return finish(cv);
};

const cache = new Map<string, Texture>();
export const texture = (id: "concrete" | "wood" | "gravel", tile: number) => {
  const key = `${id}@${tile}`;
  let t = cache.get(key);
  if (!t) {
    const base = cache.get(id) ?? (id === "concrete" ? concreteTexture() : id === "wood" ? woodTexture() : gravelTexture());
    cache.set(id, base);
    t = base.clone();
    t.repeat.set(1 / tile, 1 / tile);
    t.needsUpdate = true;
    cache.set(key, t);
  }
  return t;
};

==== 2920 src/kits/buildforge/motion/easing.ts
// PRECISION easing vocabulary. Every curve is a pure function of normalised time, so the
// whole film stays deterministic: same frame in, same pose out.

export const clamp = (x: number, lo = 0, hi = 1) => Math.min(hi, Math.max(lo, x));
export const mix = (a: number, b: number, t: number) => a + (b - a) * t;
export const remap = (x: number, a: number, b: number) => clamp((x - a) / (b - a));

export const smoothstep = (t: number) => {
  const x = clamp(t);
  return x * x * (3 - 2 * x);
};

/** C2-continuous: zero velocity and acceleration at both ends. */
export const smootherstep = (t: number) => {
  const x = clamp(t);
  return x * x * x * (x * (x * 6 - 15) + 10);
};

/** CSS-style cubic bezier easing (x1,y1,x2,y2), solved by Newton + bisection. */
export const bezier = (x1: number, y1: number, x2: number, y2: number) => {
  const cx = 3 * x1, bx = 3 * (x2 - x1) - cx, ax = 1 - cx - bx;
  const cy = 3 * y1, by = 3 * (y2 - y1) - cy, ay = 1 - cy - by;
  const sx = (t: number) => ((ax * t + bx) * t + cx) * t;
  const sy = (t: number) => ((ay * t + by) * t + cy) * t;
  const dx = (t: number) => (3 * ax * t + 2 * bx) * t + cx;
  return (x: number) => {
    const X = clamp(x);
    let t = X;
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
      const e = sx(t) - X;
      const d = dx(t);
      if (Math.abs(e) < 1e-6) return sy(t);
      if (Math.abs(d) < 1e-6) break;
      t -= e / d;
    }
    let lo = 0, hi = 1;
    t = X;
    for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
      const v = sx(t);
      if (Math.abs(v - X) < 1e-6) break;
      if (v < X) lo = t;
      else hi = t;
      t = (lo + hi) / 2;
    }
    return sy(t);
  };
};

// Named curves, tuned for product cinematography (long, confident tails; no bounce).
export const ease = {
  /** Default move: decisive start, very long settle. */
  glide: bezier(0.45, 0, 0.12, 1),
  /** Symmetric, weighty. Camera and large objects. */
  inOut: bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1),
  /** Soft symmetric for subtle drifts. */
  sine: (t: number) => 0.5 - 0.5 * Math.cos(Math.PI * clamp(t)),
  /** Starts with energy (a magnet letting go), long deceleration. */
  release: bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1),
  /** Gathers speed and arrives fast (magnetic pull into a dock). */
  attract: bezier(0.55, 0, 0.95, 0.55),
  /** Typographic reveal. */
  type: bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1),
  out: bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1),
  in: bezier(0.6, 0, 1, 1),
  smoother: smootherstep,
};

/** Eased progress of `frame` through [start, end]. */
export const seg = (frame: number, start: number, end: number, curve: (t: number) => number = ease.inOut) =>
  curve(remap(frame, start, end));

/**
 * Critically damped settle used after a mechanical stop: decays to zero with at most one
 * tiny overshoot. `t` in frames since the stop, `amp` the initial offset.
 */
export const settle = (t: number, amp: number, freq = 0.11, damping = 0.16) =>
  t <= 0 ? 0 : amp * Math.exp(-damping * t) * Math.cos(freq * t * Math.PI);

==== 2286 src/kits/buildforge/motion/track.ts
// Keyframe tracks with C1 continuity. Interior keys pass through with Catmull-Rom tangents
// (so a camera never "kinks" when one move hands over to the next); `hold` keys and the
// ends get zero tangents (a soft ease in/out). Tangents are clamped Fritsch–Carlson style
// so a curve never overshoots its keys — no accidental bounces.

/**
 * `m` overrides the tangent (units per frame), e.g. to arrive at speed for a magnetic snap;
 * `stop` makes the key an impact: it is reached at `m` and left at rest.
 */
export type Key = { f: number; v: number[]; hold?: boolean; m?: number[]; stop?: boolean };

const hermite = (p0: number, p1: number, m0: number, m1: number, t: number, h: number) => {
  const t2 = t * t, t3 = t2 * t;
  return (2 * t3 - 3 * t2 + 1) * p0 + (t3 - 2 * t2 + t) * h * m0 + (-2 * t3 + 3 * t2) * p1 + (t3 - t2) * h * m1;
};

const tangent = (keys: Key[], i: number, c: number) => {
  const k = keys[i];
  if (k.m) return k.m[c];
  if (k.hold || i === 0 || i === keys.length - 1) return 0;
  const a = keys[i - 1], b = keys[i + 1];
  const m = (b.v[c] - a.v[c]) / (b.f - a.f);
  // Monotone clamp: no overshoot past either neighbour.
  const d0 = (k.v[c] - a.v[c]) / (k.f - a.f);
  const d1 = (b.v[c] - k.v[c]) / (b.f - k.f);
  if (d0 * d1 <= 0) return 0;
  const lim = 3 * Math.min(Math.abs(d0), Math.abs(d1));
  return Math.sign(m) * Math.min(Math.abs(m), lim);
};

/** Sample a multi-channel track at `frame`. */
export const sample = (keys: Key[], frame: number): number[] => {
  if (frame <= keys[0].f) return keys[0].v.slice();
  const last = keys[keys.length - 1];
  if (frame >= last.f) return last.v.slice();
  let i = 0;
  while (i < keys.length - 2 && frame >= keys[i + 1].f) i++;
  const a = keys[i], b = keys[i + 1];
  const h = b.f - a.f;
  const t = (frame - a.f) / h;
  return a.v.map((_, c) =>
    hermite(a.v[c], b.v[c], a.stop ? 0 : tangent(keys, i, c), tangent(keys, i + 1, c), t, h),
  );
};

/** Convenience: build keys from [frame, ...values] tuples; append "hold" to pin a key. */
export const keys = (...rows: (number | "hold")[][]): Key[] =>
  rows.map((r) => {
    const hold = r[r.length - 1] === "hold";
    const nums = r.filter((x): x is number => typeof x === "number");
    return { f: nums[0], v: nums.slice(1), hold };
  });

==== 5940 src/kits/buildforge/render/Post.tsx
// Camera + finishing chain (metre scale, exterior daylight). The rig applies the shot for this frame before R3F advances,
// then the composer renders: scene (MSAA) → ground-truth AO → sanitize → depth of field → restrained
// bloom → Khronos PBR Neutral tone mapping → grade (warmth, vignette, fine grain).

import React, { useLayoutEffect, useMemo } from "react";
import { useFrame, useThree } from "@react-three/fiber";
import { HalfFloatType, NeutralToneMapping, PerspectiveCamera, Vector2, WebGLRenderTarget } from "three";
import { EffectComposer } from "three/examples/jsm/postprocessing/EffectComposer.js";
import { RenderPass } from "three/examples/jsm/postprocessing/RenderPass.js";
import { GTAOPass } from "three/examples/jsm/postprocessing/GTAOPass.js";
import { BokehPass } from "three/examples/jsm/postprocessing/BokehPass.js";
import { UnrealBloomPass } from "three/examples/jsm/postprocessing/UnrealBloomPass.js";
import { OutputPass } from "three/examples/jsm/postprocessing/OutputPass.js";
import { ShaderPass } from "three/examples/jsm/postprocessing/ShaderPass.js";

export type Shot = {
  pos: [number, number, number];
  target: [number, number, number];
  fov: number;
  roll?: number;
  /** Focus distance (world units) and lens aperture for the bokeh pass. */
  focus: number;
  aperture: number;
  maxBlur: number;
  exposure: number;
};

export const CameraRig: React.FC<{ shot: Shot }> = ({ shot }) => {
  const { camera, gl } = useThree();
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const cam = camera as PerspectiveCamera;
    cam.position.set(...shot.pos);
    cam.up.set(Math.sin(shot.roll ?? 0), Math.cos(shot.roll ?? 0), 0);
    cam.lookAt(...shot.target);
    cam.fov = shot.fov;
    cam.near = 0.4;
    cam.far = 2500;
    cam.updateProjectionMatrix();
    cam.updateMatrixWorld();
    gl.toneMapping = NeutralToneMapping;
    gl.toneMappingExposure = shot.exposure;
  }, [shot, camera, gl]);
  return null;
};

const GradeShader = {
  uniforms: {
    tDiffuse: { value: null },
    uTime: { value: 0 },
    uVignette: { value: 0.14 },
    uGrain: { value: 0.012 },
    uRes: { value: new Vector2(1080, 1920) },
  },
  vertexShader: /* glsl */ `varying vec2 vUv; void main(){ vUv = uv; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
  fragmentShader: /* glsl */ `
    uniform sampler2D tDiffuse; uniform float uTime; uniform float uVignette; uniform float uGrain; uniform vec2 uRes;
    varying vec2 vUv;
    float hash(vec2 p){ p = fract(p * vec2(443.897, 441.423)); p += dot(p, p.yx + 19.19); return fract((p.x + p.y) * p.x); }
    void main(){
      vec4 c = texture2D(tDiffuse, vUv);
      float l = dot(c.rgb, vec3(0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722));
      // ivory highlights, a breath of cool in the shadows
      c.rgb += smoothstep(0.6, 1.0, l) * vec3(0.002, 0.001, -0.003);
      c.rgb += (1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.5, l)) * vec3(-0.004, 0.0, 0.006);
      // gentle S-curve: deeper form shadows without crushing the whites
      c.rgb = mix(c.rgb, c.rgb * c.rgb * (3.0 - 2.0 * c.rgb), 0.24);
      vec2 d = (vUv - 0.5) * vec2(1.0, 1.25);
      c.rgb *= 1.0 - uVignette * smoothstep(0.35, 0.95, length(d));
      float g = hash(vUv * uRes + uTime * 17.0) - 0.5;
      c.rgb += g * uGrain;
      gl_FragColor = c;
    }`,
};

/** Keeps the HDR buffer finite before depth of field and bloom: one NaN or overflowing pixel (a sliver seen
 * edge-on, a custom shader) would otherwise be smeared over the whole frame by the bloom blur. */
const SanitizeShader = {
  uniforms: { tDiffuse: { value: null }, uMax: { value: 16 } },
  vertexShader: /* glsl */ `varying vec2 vUv; void main(){ vUv = uv; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
  fragmentShader: /* glsl */ `
    uniform sampler2D tDiffuse; uniform float uMax; varying vec2 vUv;
    void main(){
      vec4 c = texture2D(tDiffuse, vUv);
      if (any(isnan(c)) || any(isinf(c))) c = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
      gl_FragColor = vec4(clamp(c.rgb, 0.0, uMax), clamp(c.a, 0.0, 1.0));
    }`,
};

export const Post: React.FC<{ shot: Shot; frame: number; ao?: boolean; aoRadius?: number }> = ({ shot, frame, ao = true, aoRadius = 0.28 }) => {
  const { gl, scene, camera, size } = useThree();
  const chain = useMemo(() => {
    const w = size.width, h = size.height;
    const rt = new WebGLRenderTarget(w, h, { type: HalfFloatType, samples: 4 });
    const composer = new EffectComposer(gl, rt);
    composer.setPixelRatio(1);
    composer.setSize(w, h);
    composer.addPass(new RenderPass(scene, camera));
    if (ao) {
      const gtao = new GTAOPass(scene, camera, w, h);
      gtao.blendIntensity = 1.0;
      gtao.updateGtaoMaterial({ radius: aoRadius, distanceExponent: 1.8, thickness: 0.5, scale: 1.0, samples: 16, distanceFallOff: 1.0, screenSpaceRadius: false });
      gtao.updatePdMaterial({ lumaPhi: 10, depthPhi: 2, normalPhi: 3, radius: 5, rings: 2, samples: 16 });
      composer.addPass(gtao);
    }
    composer.addPass(new ShaderPass(SanitizeShader));
    const dof = new BokehPass(scene, camera, { focus: 10, aperture: 0.002, maxblur: 0.008 });
    composer.addPass(dof);
    const bloom = new UnrealBloomPass(new Vector2(w, h), 0.14, 0.45, 2.2);
    composer.addPass(bloom);
    composer.addPass(new OutputPass());
    const grade = new ShaderPass(GradeShader);
    grade.uniforms.uRes.value.set(w, h);
    composer.addPass(grade);
    return { composer, dof, grade };
  }, [gl, scene, camera, size.width, size.height, ao, aoRadius]);

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const u = chain.dof.uniforms as unknown as Record<string, { value: number }>;
    u.focus.value = shot.focus;
    u.aperture.value = shot.aperture;
    u.maxblur.value = shot.maxBlur;
    chain.dof.enabled = shot.maxBlur > 0 && shot.aperture > 0;
    chain.grade.uniforms.uTime.value = frame % 997;
  }, [frame, chain, shot]);

  useFrame(() => {
    chain.composer.render();
  }, 1);
  return null;
};

==== 12386 src/kits/buildforge/render/Site.ts
// Turns a component list + construction timeline into a three.js scene graph and poses it for
// any frame. Built once (imperatively, no React per component); `update(frame)` is pure in
// the frame: it sets transforms, material state, blueprint ghosts and crane rigging.

import {
  BoxGeometry, Color, CylinderGeometry, DynamicDrawUsage, EdgesGeometry, Group, InstancedBufferAttribute, InstancedMesh,
  LineBasicMaterial, LineSegments, Matrix4, Mesh, Quaternion, Vector3, type BufferGeometry, type Material,
} from "three";
import { pieceProgress, stateOf, type RigState } from "../assembly/motion.ts";
import type { Slot, Timeline } from "../assembly/schedule.ts";
import { pieceBounds } from "../geometry/shapes.ts";
import type { Library, BuildUniforms } from "../materials/library.ts";
import { ease } from "../motion/easing.ts";
import type { Component, Piece, Vec3 } from "../types.ts";

type Bounds = { min: Vec3; max: Vec3 };
type Base = { opacity: number; transparent: boolean; cast: boolean };
type Common = { c: Component; slot: Slot; root: Group; inner: Group; bounds: Bounds; ghost: LineSegments; ghostMat: LineBasicMaterial };
type SolidItem = Common & {
  kind: "solid";
  meshes: Mesh[];
  mats: Material[];
  base: Base[];
  spread?: { geom: BufferGeometry; rest: Float32Array };
};
type PiecesItem = Common & { kind: "pieces"; mesh: InstancedMesh; mat: Material; alpha: InstancedBufferAttribute; pieces: Piece[]; settled: boolean };
type Item = SolidItem | PiecesItem;

const GHOST = new Color("#1fae95");
const CABLE_R = 0.016;
const MAX_CABLES = 240;
const MAX_HOOKS = 60;

const bfOf = (m: Material) => m.userData.bf as BuildUniforms | undefined;

const ghostFor = (b: Bounds) => {
  const size = b.max.map((v, i) => v - b.min[i]);
  const g = new EdgesGeometry(new BoxGeometry(size[0] + 0.03, size[1] + 0.03, size[2] + 0.03));
  const mat = new LineBasicMaterial({ color: GHOST, transparent: true, opacity: 0, depthWrite: false, fog: false });
  const l = new LineSegments(g, mat);
  l.position.set(...(b.min.map((v, i) => (v + b.max[i]) / 2) as Vec3));
  l.renderOrder = 2;
  return { ghost: l, ghostMat: mat };
};

export class Site {
  readonly group = new Group();
  private items: Item[] = [];
  private cables: InstancedMesh;
  private mains: InstancedMesh;
  private hooks: InstancedMesh;

  constructor(components: Component[], timeline: Timeline, lib: Library) {
    for (const c of components) {
      const slot = timeline.get(c.id)!;
      const root = new Group();
      root.position.set(...c.at);
      root.rotation.y = c.rotY ?? 0;
      const inner = new Group();
      root.add(inner);
      this.group.add(root);
      if (c.part.kind === "solid") {
        const bounds = c.part.bounds;
        const subs = c.part.build();
        const meshes: Mesh[] = [], mats: Material[] = [], base: Base[] = [];
        for (const s of subs) {
          const id = s.material ?? c.material;
          const mat = lib.make(id, { finish: id === c.material ? c.finish : undefined });
          const mesh = new Mesh(s.geom, mat);
          const cast = c.shadow !== false && id !== "glass" && c.method.kind !== "coat";
          mesh.receiveShadow = true;
          inner.add(mesh);
          meshes.push(mesh);
          mats.push(mat);
          base.push({ opacity: mat.opacity, transparent: mat.transparent, cast });
        }
        const item: SolidItem = { kind: "solid", c, slot, root, inner, bounds, meshes, mats, base, ...ghostFor(bounds) };
        if (c.method.kind === "spread") item.spread = { geom: subs[0].geom, rest: (subs[0].geom.attributes.position.array as Float32Array).slice() };
        root.add(item.ghost);
        this.items.push(item);
      } else {
        if (c.method.kind !== "lay") throw new Error(`BUILDFORGE: pieces component ${c.id} must use "lay"`);
        const pieces = c.part.pieces;
        const bounds = pieceBounds(pieces);
        const mat = lib.make(c.material, { finish: c.finish, pieces: true });
        const mesh = new InstancedMesh(new BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1), mat, pieces.length);
        mesh.instanceMatrix.setUsage(DynamicDrawUsage);
        const alpha = new InstancedBufferAttribute(new Float32Array(pieces.length).fill(1), 1);
        alpha.setUsage(DynamicDrawUsage);
        mesh.geometry.setAttribute("aAlpha", alpha);
        const tone = new Color();
        pieces.forEach((p, i) => mesh.setColorAt(i, tone.setScalar(p.tone ?? 1)));
        mesh.castShadow = c.shadow !== false;
        mesh.receiveShadow = true;
        mesh.frustumCulled = false;
        inner.add(mesh);
        const item: PiecesItem = { kind: "pieces", c, slot, root, inner, bounds, mesh, mat, alpha, pieces, settled: false, ...ghostFor(bounds) };
        root.add(item.ghost);
        this.items.push(item);
      }
    }
    // crane rigging: one pool of cable segments and hook blocks shared by every lift
    const pool = (geom: BufferGeometry, mat: Material, n: number) => {
      mat.transparent = true;
      const m = new InstancedMesh(geom, mat, n);
      m.geometry.setAttribute("aAlpha", new InstancedBufferAttribute(new Float32Array(n), 1));
      m.frustumCulled = false;
      m.instanceMatrix.setUsage(DynamicDrawUsage);
      this.group.add(m);
      return m;
    };
    // slings, the main hoist line (fades out upward, so the crane stays implied) and hook blocks
    this.cables = pool(new CylinderGeometry(1, 1, 1, 6, 1, true), lib.make("cable", { pieces: true }), MAX_CABLES);
    this.mains = pool(new CylinderGeometry(1, 1, 1, 6, 1, true), lib.make("cable", { pieces: true, fade: true }), MAX_HOOKS);
    this.hooks = pool(new BoxGeometry(0.26, 0.36, 0.2), lib.make("hook", { pieces: true }), MAX_HOOKS);
  }

  /**
   * Pose everything for construction-clock value `frame`. `blueprint` (0..1) draws the plan
   * outline over every installed element, bottom to top — the drawing behind the building.
   */
  update(frame: number, blueprint = 0) {
    const rigs: { item: Item; rig: RigState }[] = [];
    for (const item of this.items) {
      const s = stateOf(item.c, item.slot, frame);
      item.inner.visible = s.visible;
      let ghost = s.ghost;
      if (blueprint > 0 && s.visible && s.lin >= 1 && !item.c.exit && !["grow", "drive", "draw"].includes(item.c.method.kind)) {
        const h = (item.c.at[1] + item.bounds.min[1] + 0.5) / 8;
        ghost = Math.max(ghost, Math.min(1, Math.max(0, blueprint * 1.6 - h * 0.6)));
      }
      item.ghostMat.opacity = ghost * 0.95;
      item.ghost.visible = ghost > 0.003;
      item.inner.position.set(...s.offset);
      item.inner.scale.set(...s.scale);
      item.inner.rotation.y = s.yaw;
      if (item.kind === "solid") this.poseSolid(item, s.opacity, s.wet, s.u, s.lin);
      else this.posePieces(item, s.lin);
      if (s.rig && s.visible) rigs.push({ item, rig: s.rig });
    }
    this.group.updateMatrixWorld(true);
    this.poseRigs(rigs);
  }

  private poseSolid(item: SolidItem, opacity: number, wet: number, u: number, lin: number) {
    item.mats.forEach((m, i) => {
      const b = item.base[i];
      const tr = b.transparent || opacity < 0.999;
      if (m.transparent !== tr) {
        m.transparent = tr;
        m.needsUpdate = true;
      }
      m.opacity = b.opacity * opacity;
      const bf = bfOf(m);
      if (bf) {
        bf.uWet.value = wet;
        if (item.c.method.kind === "coat") {
          const y0 = item.c.at[1] + item.bounds.min[1], y1 = item.c.at[1] + item.bounds.max[1];
          bf.uCoat.value = lin >= 1 ? 1e5 : y0 - 0.02 + u * (y1 - y0 + 0.04);
        }
      }
    });
    item.meshes.forEach((mesh, i) => (mesh.castShadow = item.base[i].cast && opacity > 0.3));
    if (item.spread) this.deformPour(item, u);
  }

  /** Pour front: top vertices ahead of the front sink below the base, a ramp leads it. */
  private deformPour(item: SolidItem, u: number) {
    const m = item.c.method;
    if (m.kind !== "spread" || !item.spread) return;
    const { geom, rest } = item.spread;
    const pos = geom.attributes.position.array as Float32Array;
    const a = m.axis === "x" ? 0 : 2;
    const lo = item.bounds.min[a], hi = item.bounds.max[a], y0 = item.bounds.min[1], sink = y0 - 0.06;
    const front = m.dir > 0 ? lo + (hi - lo + m.ramp) * u : hi - (hi - lo + m.ramp) * u;
    for (let i = 0; i < pos.length; i += 3) {
      const x = rest[i + a], y = rest[i + 1];
      const k = u >= 1 ? 1 : Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (m.dir > 0 ? front - x : x - front) / m.ramp));
      pos[i] = rest[i];
      pos[i + 2] = rest[i + 2];
      pos[i + 1] = y > y0 + 1e-4 ? sink + (y - sink) * k : y;
    }
    geom.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true;
    geom.computeVertexNormals();
    geom.computeBoundingSphere();
  }

  private posePieces(item: PiecesItem, lin: number) {
    const m = item.c.method;
    if (m.kind !== "lay") return;
    const n = item.pieces.length;
    const done = lin >= 1;
    if (done && item.settled) return;
    const mtx = new Matrix4(), q = new Quaternion(), p = new Vector3(), sc = new Vector3();
    let fading = false;
    item.pieces.forEach((pc, i) => {
      const t = pieceProgress(i, n, lin, m.each);
      let a = 1;
      if (pc.instant ? t < 1 : t <= 0) sc.set(0, 0, 0);
      else sc.set(...pc.s);
      const e = pc.instant ? 1 : ease.glide(t);
      p.set(pc.c[0] + m.from[0] * (1 - e), pc.c[1] + m.from[1] * (1 - e), pc.c[2] + m.from[2] * (1 - e));
      if (!pc.instant) a = Math.min(1, t / 0.3);
      if (a < 1 && t > 0) fading = true;
      mtx.compose(p, q, sc);
      item.mesh.setMatrixAt(i, mtx);
      item.alpha.setX(i, a);
    });
    item.mesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
    item.alpha.needsUpdate = true;
    if (item.mat.transparent !== fading) {
      item.mat.transparent = fading;
      item.mat.needsUpdate = true;
    }
    item.settled = done;
  }

  private poseRigs(rigs: { item: Item; rig: RigState }[]) {
    const n = { cables: 0, mains: 0, hooks: 0 };
    const mtx = new Matrix4(), q = new Quaternion(), up = new Vector3(0, 1, 0), d = new Vector3(), mid = new Vector3(), sc = new Vector3();
    const put = (key: "cables" | "mains" | "hooks", alpha: number) => {
      const mesh = this[key];
      if (n[key] >= (key === "cables" ? MAX_CABLES : MAX_HOOKS)) return;
      mesh.setMatrixAt(n[key], mtx);
      (mesh.geometry.attributes.aAlpha as InstancedBufferAttribute).setX(n[key]++, alpha);
    };
    const seg = (a: Vector3, b: Vector3, alpha: number, key: "cables" | "mains") => {
      d.subVectors(b, a);
      const len = d.length();
      q.setFromUnitVectors(up, d.normalize());
      mid.addVectors(a, b).multiplyScalar(0.5);
      mtx.compose(mid, q, sc.set(CABLE_R, len, CABLE_R));
      put(key, alpha);
    };
    for (const { item, rig } of rigs) {
      const { min, max } = item.bounds;
      const cx = (min[0] + max[0]) / 2, cz = (min[2] + max[2]) / 2, top = max[1];
      const lx = max[0] - min[0], lz = max[2] - min[2];
      const local: Vec3[] =
        rig.kind === "single"
          ? [[cx, top, cz]]
          : rig.kind === "sling"
            ? lx >= lz
              ? [[cx - 0.38 * lx, top, cz], [cx + 0.38 * lx, top, cz]]
              : [[cx, top, cz - 0.38 * lz], [cx, top, cz + 0.38 * lz]]
            : [[cx - 0.4 * lx, top, cz - 0.4 * lz], [cx + 0.4 * lx, top, cz - 0.4 * lz], [cx + 0.4 * lx, top, cz + 0.4 * lz], [cx - 0.4 * lx, top, cz + 0.4 * lz]];
      const lift = new Vector3(0, rig.lift * 7, 0);
      const ends = local.map((v) => item.inner.localToWorld(new Vector3(...v)).add(lift));
      const centre = item.inner.localToWorld(new Vector3(cx, top, cz)).add(lift);
      const span = Math.max(lx, lz);
      const rise = rig.kind === "single" ? 0.45 : Math.min(rig.kind === "four" ? 4.2 : 3.2, 0.46 * span) + 0.2;
      const hook = centre.clone().add(new Vector3(0, rise, 0));
      for (const e of ends) seg(e, hook, rig.alpha, "cables");
      seg(hook.clone().add(new Vector3(0, 0.36, 0)), hook.clone().add(new Vector3(0, 80, 0)), rig.alpha, "mains");
      mtx.compose(hook.clone().add(new Vector3(0, 0.18, 0)), new Quaternion(), sc.set(1, 1, 1));
      put("hooks", rig.alpha);
    }
    for (const key of ["cables", "mains", "hooks"] as const) {
      const mesh = this[key];
      mesh.count = n[key];
      mesh.visible = n[key] > 0;
      mesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
      mesh.geometry.attributes.aAlpha.needsUpdate = true;
    }
  }
}

==== 3613 src/kits/buildforge/types.ts
// BUILDFORGE core vocabulary. A structure is a flat list of components; each one knows its
// seat (final pose), how it physically arrives there (method), what it bears on, and which
// phase installs it. Timing lives in the assembly sequence, never in the component.

import type { BufferGeometry } from "three";

export type Vec3 = [number, number, number];

/** One physical piece of a multi-piece component (a block, a slat, a board): local centre and size, metres. */
export type Piece = {
  c: Vec3;
  s: Vec3;
  /** Brightness multiplier (natural variation between blocks or boards). */
  tone?: number;
  /** Bedding material: appears in place when its turn comes instead of being carried in. */
  instant?: boolean;
};

/** A sub-mesh of a solid component; `material` overrides the component's own. */
export type SubMesh = { geom: BufferGeometry; material?: string };

export type Part =
  /**
   * One rigid element (column, beam, plank, window unit…). Built lazily: the check script never
   * needs GL. `boxes` is an exact box decomposition for clash checks when bounds would lie
   * (a coat with openings, a planter around its soil).
   */
  | { kind: "solid"; build: () => SubMesh[]; bounds: { min: Vec3; max: Vec3 }; boxes?: [Vec3, Vec3][] }
  /** Many identical small elements placed one after another (masonry, cladding slats, deck boards). */
  | { kind: "pieces"; pieces: Piece[] };

/** How a component physically reaches its seat. Offsets are in the component's local frame. */
export type Method =
  /** Crane lift: hangs from a hook, comes straight down, the rigging lifts away after set-down. */
  | { kind: "lower"; height: number; rig: "single" | "sling" | "four" }
  /** Carried in by installers along an offset (windows into openings, boards into place). */
  | { kind: "slide"; from: Vec3 }
  /** Poured or placed material rising from the bottom of its form (footings, gravel). */
  | { kind: "fill"; cure?: boolean }
  /** A pour front advancing across the form, with a sloped leading edge (slabs). Needs a geometry subdivided along `axis`. */
  | { kind: "spread"; axis: "x" | "z"; dir: 1 | -1; ramp: number; cure?: boolean }
  /** Hammered into the ground in blows (survey stakes). */
  | { kind: "drive"; depth: number }
  /** A line pulled taut from its start (local x) to its end. */
  | { kind: "draw" }
  /** Planting growing from its base. */
  | { kind: "grow" }
  /** A finish coat applied bottom → top behind a travelling front (render, plaster). */
  | { kind: "coat" }
  /** Pieces laid one by one; `each` = share of the component window one piece's move takes. */
  | { kind: "lay"; from: Vec3; each: number };

export type Component = {
  id: string;
  /** Assembly phase that installs it; the sequence gives each phase a time window. */
  phase: string;
  part: Part;
  /** Seat: world position of the part's local origin once installed. */
  at: Vec3;
  rotY?: number;
  material: string;
  method: Method;
  /** Components this one bears on or is fixed to: they must be complete before it starts. */
  rests?: string[];
  /** Procedural predecessors that carry no load (e.g. the slab is poured after the formwork is set). */
  after?: string[];
  /** Order inside its phase window; equal keys start together. Defaults to list order. */
  key?: number;
  /** Temporary works (stakes, formwork, spoil) leave the site during this phase, by the reverse of `method`. */
  exit?: string;
  /** Surface turns into this material when the named finish sweep passes over it. */
  finish?: { material: string; sweep: string };
  ghost?: boolean;
  shadow?: boolean;
};

==== 7474 src/kits/buildforge/world/createWorld.ts
// Generic BUILDFORGE world: sky, sun with soft shadows, graded terrain, the structure's components on
// their construction timeline, and existing trees around the site. Built once; `update(c, look)` poses
// the build for construction-clock value `c` and sets the light of the moment.
//
// A film supplies its own components, phase windows, site spec and terrain/finish timing; everything
// else (looks, sky, ground, foliage palettes) defaults to the daylight preset.

import { Color, DirectionalLight, Fog, Group, HemisphereLight, Mesh, Vector3, type Material, type Scene, type ShaderMaterial, type WebGLRenderer } from "three";
import { schedule, type PhaseWindow, type Timeline } from "../assembly/schedule.ts";
import { createSky, skyEnvironment, type SkyLook } from "../environment/Sky.ts";
import { Terrain, type GroundLook, type SiteSpec, type TerrainState } from "../environment/Terrain.ts";
import { roundTree, shrub, type Palette } from "../environment/Vegetation.ts";
import { rng } from "../geometry/noise.ts";
import { createLibrary, makeSweep, type Library, type Look, type Sweep } from "../materials/library.ts";
import { Site } from "../render/Site.ts";
import type { Component, SubMesh } from "../types.ts";
import { FOG, GROUND, LEAF, LOOKS, SKY } from "../presets/daylight.ts";

export type WorldLook = {
  /** Sun azimuth (0 = front/+z, positive toward +x) and elevation, degrees. */
  sunAz: number;
  sunEl: number;
  /** 0 = neutral daylight, 1 = warm late-afternoon light. */
  warmth: number;
  cloudShift: number;
  /** Light fittings (materials with `emissive` in their look), 0..1. */
  lamps: number;
  /** Blueprint ghosts of every component not yet installed, 0..1. */
  blueprint: number;
};

export const sunLook = (dir: [number, number, number], over: Partial<WorldLook> = {}): WorldLook => {
  const v = new Vector3(...dir).normalize();
  return {
    sunAz: (Math.atan2(v.x, v.z) * 180) / Math.PI,
    sunEl: (Math.asin(v.y) * 180) / Math.PI,
    warmth: 0,
    cloudShift: 0,
    lamps: 0,
    blueprint: 0,
    ...over,
  };
};

export type WorldSpec = {
  /** Every component of the structure (and plantings), and the phase windows on the construction clock. */
  components: Component[];
  windows: PhaseWindow[];
  site: SiteSpec;
  /** Ground operations over the construction clock (contours, grading, excavation, backfill, lawn). */
  terrainAt: (c: number) => TerrainState;
  /** Finish sweeps: id → direction/softness, and the front's position over the clock. */
  sweeps?: Record<string, { dir: [number, number, number]; soft: number; front: (c: number) => number }>;
  looks?: Record<string, Look>;
  sky?: SkyLook;
  fog?: string;
  ground?: GroundLook;
  /** Existing trees: [x, z, height]. Those within `shadowRadius` of the origin cast shadows. */
  trees?: [number, number, number][];
  treeLeaf?: Palette;
  /** Extra distant trees scattered on a ring (count, inner radius, outer radius). */
  scatter?: [number, number, number];
  /** Sun direction used for the sky's environment lighting; half-size of the shadow frustum. */
  sunDir?: [number, number, number];
  shadowSize?: number;
  shadowRadius?: number;
};

export type World = {
  root: Group;
  components: Component[];
  timeline: Timeline;
  lib: Library;
  terrain: Terrain;
  update: (c: number, look: WorldLook) => void;
};

const D = Math.PI / 180;

export const createWorld = (gl: WebGLRenderer, scene: Scene, spec: WorldSpec): World => {
  const looks = spec.looks ?? LOOKS;
  const skyLook = spec.sky ?? SKY;
  const sunDir = new Vector3(...(spec.sunDir ?? [-0.55, 0.62, 0.56])).normalize();
  const root = new Group();
  scene.fog = new Fog(new Color(spec.fog ?? FOG), 110, 1300);
  scene.environment = skyEnvironment(gl, skyLook, sunDir);
  scene.environmentIntensity = 0.42;
  const sky = createSky(skyLook, sunDir);
  root.add(sky);
  const skyU = (sky.material as ShaderMaterial).uniforms;

  const DAY = new Color("#ffeed6"), WARM = new Color("#ffd8a4");
  const sun = new DirectionalLight(DAY.clone(), 3.1);
  const s = spec.shadowSize ?? 24;
  const aim = new Vector3(0, 0, 0);
  sun.position.copy(aim).addScaledVector(sunDir, 100);
  sun.target.position.copy(aim);
  sun.castShadow = true;
  sun.shadow.mapSize.set(4096, 4096);
  Object.assign(sun.shadow.camera, { left: -s, right: s, top: s, bottom: -s, near: 30, far: 190 });
  sun.shadow.camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
  sun.shadow.bias = -0.0002;
  sun.shadow.normalBias = 0.03;
  sun.shadow.radius = 2.5;
  root.add(sun, sun.target, new HemisphereLight(new Color("#d4e4f3"), new Color("#d6caae"), 0.36));

  const terrain = new Terrain(spec.site, spec.ground ?? GROUND);
  root.add(terrain.mesh);

  const sweepDefs = spec.sweeps ?? {};
  const sweeps: Record<string, Sweep> = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(sweepDefs).map(([id, d]) => [id, makeSweep(d.dir, d.soft)]));
  const lib = createLibrary(looks, sweeps);
  const components = spec.components;
  const timeline = schedule(components, spec.windows);
  const site = new Site(components, timeline, lib);
  root.add(site.group);

  // existing trees: a few shared variants, scaled and turned
  const leaf = spec.treeLeaf ?? LEAF.wild;
  const mats: Record<string, Material> = { bark: lib.make("bark"), foliage: lib.make("foliage") };
  const variants = [3, 7, 11, 17, 23].map((seed) => roundTree(10, seed, leaf, 1.25));
  const ground0 = spec.terrainAt(0);
  const placeTree = (subs: SubMesh[], x: number, z: number, h: number, yaw: number, cast: boolean) => {
    const y = terrain.height(x, z, ground0) - 0.1;
    for (const sm of subs) {
      const m = new Mesh(sm.geom, mats[sm.material ?? "foliage"]);
      m.position.set(x, y, z);
      m.scale.setScalar(h / 10);
      m.rotation.y = yaw;
      m.castShadow = cast;
      m.receiveShadow = true;
      root.add(m);
    }
  };
  const r = rng(77);
  const near = spec.shadowRadius ?? 45;
  (spec.trees ?? []).forEach(([x, z, h], i) => placeTree(variants[i % variants.length], x, z, h, r() * 6.28, Math.hypot(x, z) < near));
  const [count, r0, r1] = spec.scatter ?? [30, 80, 260];
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const a = r() * Math.PI * 2, d = r0 + r() * (r1 - r0);
    placeTree(variants[i % variants.length], Math.cos(a) * d, Math.sin(a) * d, 7 + r() * 6, r() * 6.28, false);
  }
  // low meadow scrub outside the site, for scale
  const scrub = [41, 42, 43].map((seed) => shrub(0.7, seed, leaf, 4));
  const a = spec.site.site;
  for (let i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
    const ang = r() * Math.PI * 2, d = 22 + r() * 60;
    const x = Math.cos(ang) * d, z = Math.sin(ang) * d;
    if (x > a.x0 - 3 && x < a.x1 + 3 && z > a.z0 - 3 && z < a.z1 + 3) continue;
    placeTree(scrub[i % 3], x, z, 10 * (0.6 + r() * 0.8), r() * 6.28, d < near);
  }

  const dir = new Vector3();
  return {
    root,
    components,
    timeline,
    lib,
    terrain,
    update(c: number, look: WorldLook) {
      terrain.update(spec.terrainAt(c));
      for (const [id, d] of Object.entries(sweepDefs)) sweeps[id].front.value = d.front(c);
      site.update(c, look.blueprint);
      lib.setLamps(look.lamps);
      const az = look.sunAz * D, el = look.sunEl * D;
      dir.set(Math.cos(el) * Math.sin(az), Math.sin(el), Math.cos(el) * Math.cos(az));
      sun.position.copy(aim).addScaledVector(dir, 100);
      sun.color.copy(DAY).lerp(WARM, look.warmth);
      skyU.uSunDir.value.copy(dir);
      skyU.uShift.value.set(look.cloudShift, look.cloudShift * 0.35);
    },
  };
};
